# KAVACH — Engineering Change Log

> All changes scoped to the five evaluation criteria.

---

## Task 2 — Signal-to-Recommendation Loop

**New file:** `src/lib/engine/signalMapper.ts`  
Maps `RiskAssessment.impacted_chokepoint` enum values to actual `blocked_nodes[]` IDs in `network.json`. Handles `"Multiple"` by scanning `event_summary` for keyword hints before falling back to `["strait_of_hormuz", "bab_el_mandeb"]`.

**Modified:** `src/app/api/engine/simulate/route.ts`  
Added `mode: "preset" | "dynamic"` toggle. Dynamic mode accepts raw `blocked_nodes[]`, `threat_level`, and `risk_score` directly from a `RiskAssessment`, bypassing the hardcoded scenario presets. Returns `signalToRecommendationMs` when a `signalTimestamp` is provided.

**Modified:** `src/app/page.tsx`  
`handleAnalyze()` now auto-triggers `runDynamicSimulation()` via `signalMapper.ts` whenever `risk_score >= RISK_THRESHOLDS.MEDIUM`. The preset flow is unchanged and remains the default.

**Modified:** `src/components/dashboard/LiveTicker.tsx`  
Added `signalToRecommendationMs` prop. Renders amber `⚡ N.Ns` badge when set.

---

## Task 3 — Supplier Graph Expansion + Executable Alternatives

**Modified:** `src/data/network.json`  
Added 4 new supplier nodes and all relevant edges:
- `basra_terminal` — Iraq, 3.5M BPD, Sour
- `bonny_terminal` — Nigeria, 2.0M BPD, Sweet
- `cabinda_terminal` — Angola, 1.2M BPD, Sweet
- `houston_port` — USA, 1.5M BPD, Sweet

Each new supplier has edges to Cape of Good Hope and then to Indian ports, with realistic `distance_nm`, `cost_per_barrel`, and `transit_days`.

**Modified:** `src/lib/agents/riskParser.ts`  
Added `getAvailableSupplierNames()` that reads live node list from `network.json`. `buildPrompt()` injects this list, grounding Gemini recommendations in actual graph nodes.

**Modified:** `src/app/api/engine/simulate/route.ts`  
`buildTopAlternatives()` generates plain-language rationale strings for top-3 viable routes:  
`"Nigeria (Bonny) → Cape → Jamnagar. ✓ Grade compatible (Sweet crude). Total: $11.82/bbl, 26d transit. Capacity: 1.20M BPD."`

**New file:** `src/components/dashboard/AlternativesPanel.tsx`  
Displays top-3 alternatives with rank badge, cost/bbl, transit days, capacity, grade compat indicator, and rationale text.

**Modified:** `src/components/dashboard/RiskPanel.tsx`  
Added `alternatives` prop and renders `AlternativesPanel` below the macro shock section.

---

## Task 1 — Live News Ingestion Pipeline

**New file:** `src/lib/ingestion/newsFeed.ts`  
- `fetchGdeltArticles()` — GDELT DOC 2.0 API, no auth required, returns up to 25 articles per query
- `fetchNewsApiArticles()` — NewsAPI.org, requires `NEWSAPI_KEY` env var (skips gracefully if missing)
- `deduplicateArticles()` — URL + title similarity dedup
- `relevanceScore()` — 4-keyword hit relevance pre-filter (saves Gemini quota)
- `getLatestArticles()` — file-cache at `src/data/news_cache.json` with 30-minute TTL

**New file:** `src/app/api/ingestion/news/live/route.ts`  
`GET /api/ingestion/news/live?hours=6`  
Fetches articles, pre-filters, runs Gemini on candidates, returns `detectionLatencyMs` (article publishedAt → ingested timestamp).

**New file:** `src/hooks/useNewsFeed.ts`  
React hook polling `/api/ingestion/news/live` every 5 minutes. Deduplicates across polls. Fires `onHighRiskAlert` callback for new high-risk articles. Exposes `latestDetectionMs` for display.

**Modified:** `src/components/dashboard/IntelligencePanel.tsx`  
New "Live Feed" section above the paste box shows last 3 real-time alerts with threat badge and detection latency. Clicking an alert loads it into the analyze flow.

---

## Task 4 — Explicit Assumptions + Sensitivity Band

**Modified:** `src/lib/engine/sprSimulator.ts`  
`simulate()` and `_computeTrajectory()` now accept optional `domesticProductionPct` override.  
`worstCaseSupplyBPD()` and `reroutedSupplyBPD()` accept `rerouteRecoveryPct` and `domesticProductionPct` overrides.

**Modified:** `src/lib/engine/macroImpact.ts`  
`compute()` accepts optional `gdpFrictionUsdPerBarrel`, `fuelPriceSpikeMultiplier`, `refineryRunrateMultiplier` overrides. Local variables use overrides; module-level constants remain as documented defaults.

**Modified:** `src/app/api/engine/simulate/route.ts`  
Threads `assumptionOverrides` from request body through both engine calls. Runs `computeSensitivityBand()` at `rerouteRecoveryPct ± 0.20`. Returns `assumptions` object (all active values) and `sensitivityBand` in every response.

**Modified:** `src/components/dashboard/ExecutiveBriefModal.tsx`  
Added "Model Assumptions & Sensitivity" accordion below brief content listing all 6 constants plus Gemini's disruption estimate. Shows `±20% recovery sensitivity band` when available.

---

## Task 5 — Geospatial Depth

**Modified:** `src/app/api/fleet/telemetry/route.ts`  
`GET` handler now reads `?blockedNodes=comma,separated,list` query param from client.  
Merges dynamic blocked nodes with scenario preset blocked nodes for correct map rendering in dynamic simulation mode.

**Modified:** `src/data/network.json`  
New supplier nodes appear in the node list and are picked up by the telemetry route's `nodeFeatures` mapper, so they render as supplier markers on the map.

FILE: src\app\api\engine\simulate\route.ts
==================================================

// ============================================================
// KAVACH — Full Scenario Simulation API Route
// POST /api/engine/simulate
//
// Accepts two modes:
//   "preset"  — one of 5 hardcoded ScenarioIds (unchanged)
//   "dynamic" — raw blocked_nodes[] derived from a live
//               RiskAssessment via signalMapper.ts
//
// Also accepts optional assumptionOverrides to override the
// default simulation constants for sensitivity testing.
//
// Returns signalToRecommendationMs and sensitivityBand.
// ============================================================

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { DigitalTwin } from "@/lib/engine/digitalTwin";
import { Rerouter, RouteOption } from "@/lib/engine/rerouter";
import { SPRSimulator } from "@/lib/engine/sprSimulator";
import { MacroImpactCalculator } from "@/lib/engine/macroImpact";
import { SCENARIOS, ScenarioId, ThreatLevel } from "@/lib/config";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

// ── Input types ──────────────────────────────────────────────

interface AssumptionOverrides {
  rerouteRecoveryPct?: number;          // default 0.60
  domesticProductionPct?: number;       // default 0.12
  gdpFrictionUsdPerBarrel?: number;     // default 42
  fuelPriceSpikeMultiplier?: number;    // default 1.45
  refineryRunrateMultiplier?: number;   // default 0.85
}

interface DynamicInput {
  blocked_nodes: string[];
  risk_score: number;
  threat_level: ThreatLevel;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  source_article_url?: string;
}

interface SimulateRequestBody {
  mode?: "preset" | "dynamic";
  scenarioId?: ScenarioId;
  dynamicInput?: DynamicInput;
  assumptionOverrides?: AssumptionOverrides;
  signalTimestamp?: number; // ms since epoch — when RiskAssessment was produced
}

// ── Route handlers ───────────────────────────────────────────

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const requestReceivedAt = Date.now();

  try {
    const body = (await req.json()) as SimulateRequestBody;
    const mode = body.mode ?? "preset";

    // ── Resolve scenario parameters ─────────────────────────
    let scenarioId: string;
    let blockedNodes: string[];
    let scenarioMeta: {
      label: string;
      description: string;
      threat_level: ThreatLevel;
      risk_score: number;
      blocked_nodes: string[];
      source_article_url?: string;
    };

    if (mode === "preset") {
      const sid = body.scenarioId;
      if (!sid || !(sid in SCENARIOS)) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error: `Invalid scenarioId. Valid options: ${Object.keys(SCENARIOS).join(", ")}`,
          },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }
      const scenario = SCENARIOS[sid];
      scenarioId = sid;
      blockedNodes = [...scenario.blocked_nodes];
      scenarioMeta = {
        label: scenario.label,
        description: scenario.description,
        threat_level: scenario.threat_level,
        risk_score: scenario.risk_score,
        blocked_nodes: blockedNodes,
      };
    } else {
      // dynamic mode
      const di = body.dynamicInput;
      if (!di) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "dynamicInput is required when mode='dynamic'" },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }
      scenarioId = `DYNAMIC_${Date.now()}`;
      blockedNodes = di.blocked_nodes ?? [];
      scenarioMeta = {
        label: di.label,
        description: di.description,
        threat_level: di.threat_level,
        risk_score: di.risk_score,
        blocked_nodes: blockedNodes,
        source_article_url: di.source_article_url,
      };
    }

    const overrides = body.assumptionOverrides ?? {};

    // ── 1. Digital Twin + Rerouter ─────────────────────────
    const twin = new DigitalTwin();
    const rerouter = new Rerouter(twin);

    const rerouteResult = rerouter.computeRerouting(scenarioId, blockedNodes);

    // ── 2. SPR Drawdown Simulation ─────────────────────────
    const sprSim = new SPRSimulator();

    const unmitigatedSupply = SPRSimulator.worstCaseSupplyBPD(
      overrides.domesticProductionPct
    );
    const reroutedSupply = SPRSimulator.reroutedSupplyBPD(
      rerouteResult.supplyDeficitPct,
      overrides.rerouteRecoveryPct,
      overrides.domesticProductionPct
    );

    const sprResult = sprSim.simulate(
      unmitigatedSupply,
      reroutedSupply,
      scenarioId,
      new Date(),
      {
        domesticProductionPct: overrides.domesticProductionPct,
      }
    );

    // ── 3. Macro-Economic Impact ───────────────────────────
    const macroCalc = new MacroImpactCalculator();

    const macroResult = macroCalc.compute(
      rerouteResult.supplyDeficitPct,
      rerouteResult.avgRerouteCostIncrease,
      rerouteResult.avgRerouteDelayDays,
      scenarioId,
      new Date(),
      {
        gdpFrictionUsdPerBarrel: overrides.gdpFrictionUsdPerBarrel,
        fuelPriceSpikeMultiplier: overrides.fuelPriceSpikeMultiplier,
        refineryRunrateMultiplier: overrides.refineryRunrateMultiplier,
      }
    );

    // ── 4. Sensitivity band (rerouteRecoveryPct ± 0.20) ───
    const basePct = overrides.rerouteRecoveryPct ?? 0.6;
    const sensitivityBand = computeSensitivityBand(
      rerouteResult.supplyDeficitPct,
      scenarioId,
      basePct,
      overrides
    );

    // ── 5. Top-3 alternatives with rationale ──────────────
    const top3Alternatives = buildTopAlternatives(
      rerouteResult.routes,
      blockedNodes,
      twin
    );

    // ── 6. Node States for Map ─────────────────────────────
    const allNodes = twin.getAllNodes().map((node) => ({
      ...node,
      isBlocked: blockedNodes.includes(node.id),
    }));

    const allEdges = twin.getAllEdges().map((edge) => {
      const fromBlocked = blockedNodes.includes(edge.from);
      const toBlocked = blockedNodes.includes(edge.to);
      const isBlocked = fromBlocked || toBlocked;

      const isPrimary =
        edge.from === "strait_of_hormuz" || edge.to === "strait_of_hormuz";

      let status: "PRIMARY" | "REROUTED" | "BLOCKED" = "PRIMARY";
      if (isBlocked) status = "BLOCKED";
      else if (!edge.is_primary) status = "REROUTED";

      return { ...edge, isBlocked, isPrimary, status };
    });

    // ── 7. Timing ──────────────────────────────────────────
    const responseProducedAt = Date.now();
    const signalToRecommendationMs = body.signalTimestamp
      ? responseProducedAt - body.signalTimestamp
      : null;

    // ── Response Assembly ──────────────────────────────────
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: true,
        mode,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        signalToRecommendationMs,
        scenario: scenarioMeta,
        rerouting: {
          blockedBPD: rerouteResult.blockedBPD,
          activeBPD: rerouteResult.activeBPD,
          unservedBPD: rerouteResult.unservedBPD,
          supplyDeficitPct: rerouteResult.supplyDeficitPct,
          avgRerouteCostIncrease: rerouteResult.avgRerouteCostIncrease,
          avgRerouteDelayDays: rerouteResult.avgRerouteDelayDays,
          routeCount: rerouteResult.routes.length,
          reroutedCount: rerouteResult.reroutedRoutes.length,
          blockedCount: rerouteResult.blockedRoutes.length,
          top3Alternatives,
        },
        spr: {
          initialBarrels: sprResult.initialSPRBarrels,
          initialDays: sprResult.initialSPRDays,
          exhaustionDayUnmitigated: sprResult.exhaustionDayUnmitigated,
          exhaustionDayRerouted: sprResult.exhaustionDayRerouted,
          daysSaved: sprResult.daysSaved,
          trajectoryUnmitigated: sprResult.trajectoryUnmitigated,
          trajectoryRerouted: sprResult.trajectoryRerouted,
        },
        macro: {
          supplyDeficitBPD: macroResult.supplyDeficitBPD,
          supplyDeficitPct: macroResult.supplyDeficitPct,
          fuelPriceSpikePercentage: macroResult.fuelPriceSpikePercentage,
          refineryRunRateDropPct: macroResult.refineryRunRateDropPct,
          dailyGDPLossUSD: macroResult.dailyGDPLossUSD,
          fifteenDayGDPLossUSD: macroResult.fifteenDayGDPLossUSD,
          fuelPriceSpikeLabel: macroResult.fuelPriceSpikeLabel,
          gdpLossLabel: macroResult.gdpLossLabel,
          refineryHitLabel: macroResult.refineryHitLabel,
          supplyDeficitLabel: macroResult.supplyDeficitLabel,
          macroAlertLevel: macroResult.macroAlertLevel,
          crudePriceBreakevenUSD: macroResult.crudePriceBreakevenUSD,
          additionalImportCostPerDay: macroResult.additionalImportCostPerDay,
          dailyImpactSeries: macroResult.dailyImpactSeries,
        },
        sensitivityBand,
        assumptions: {
          rerouteRecoveryPct: overrides.rerouteRecoveryPct ?? 0.6,
          domesticProductionPct: overrides.domesticProductionPct ?? 0.12,
          gdpFrictionUsdPerBarrel: overrides.gdpFrictionUsdPerBarrel ?? 42,
          fuelPriceSpikeMultiplier: overrides.fuelPriceSpikeMultiplier ?? 1.45,
          refineryRunrateMultiplier: overrides.refineryRunrateMultiplier ?? 0.85,
          sprBaselineDays: 9.5,
          sprBaselineBarrels: 47500000,
        },
        network: {
          nodes: allNodes,
          edges: allEdges,
        },
      },
      { status: 200 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error";
    console.error("[KAVACH] Simulation error:", message);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: message },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Run a ±20% sensitivity check on rerouteRecoveryPct.
 * Returns the spread in daysSaved and dailyGDPLossUSD.
 */
function computeSensitivityBand(
  deficitPct: number,
  scenarioId: string,
  baseRecoveryPct: number,
  overrides: AssumptionOverrides
) {
  const variants = [
    Math.max(0, baseRecoveryPct - 0.2),
    Math.min(1, baseRecoveryPct + 0.2),
  ];

  const results = variants.map((recoveryPct) => {
    const reroutedSupply = SPRSimulator.reroutedSupplyBPD(
      deficitPct,
      recoveryPct,
      overrides.domesticProductionPct
    );
    const unmitigatedSupply = SPRSimulator.worstCaseSupplyBPD(
      overrides.domesticProductionPct
    );
    const sim = new SPRSimulator();
    const r = sim.simulate(
      unmitigatedSupply,
      reroutedSupply,
      scenarioId,
      new Date(),
      { domesticProductionPct: overrides.domesticProductionPct }
    );
    const macro = new MacroImpactCalculator();
    const m = macro.compute(deficitPct, 0, 0, scenarioId, new Date(), {
      gdpFrictionUsdPerBarrel: overrides.gdpFrictionUsdPerBarrel,
      fuelPriceSpikeMultiplier: overrides.fuelPriceSpikeMultiplier,
      refineryRunrateMultiplier: overrides.refineryRunrateMultiplier,
    });
    return { daysSaved: r.daysSaved, dailyGDPLossUSD: m.dailyGDPLossUSD };
  });

  return {
    recoveryRangeLow: variants[0],
    recoveryRangeHigh: variants[1],
    daysSavedLow: results[0].daysSaved,
    daysSavedHigh: results[1].daysSaved,
    gdpLossLow: results[0].dailyGDPLossUSD,
    gdpLossHigh: results[1].dailyGDPLossUSD,
  };
}

/**
 * Build top-3 rerouted alternatives with plain-language rationale strings.
 * Sorted by totalCostPerBarrel ascending (cheapest first).
 */
function buildTopAlternatives(
  routes: RouteOption[],
  blockedNodes: string[],
  twin: DigitalTwin
): Array<RouteOption & { rationale: string }> {
  // Filter to rerouted (not blocked, not primary Hormuz path)
  const viable = routes
    .filter((r) => !r.isBlocked && r.capacityBPD > 0)
    .sort((a, b) => a.totalCostPerBarrel - b.totalCostPerBarrel)
    .slice(0, 3);

  return viable.map((r) => {
    const gradeNote = r.gradeMismatch
      ? `⚠ Grade mismatch (${r.crudeType} crude, +$${r.gradeSurchargePBL}/bbl surcharge, +${r.gradeDelayDays}d)`
      : `✓ Grade compatible (${r.crudeType} crude)`;

    const routeVia = r.pathLabels.slice(1, -1).join(" → ") || "direct";
    const rationale = `${r.supplier.label} → ${r.port.label} via ${routeVia}. ${gradeNote}. Total: $${r.totalCostPerBarrel.toFixed(2)}/bbl, ${r.totalTransitDays}d transit. Capacity: ${(r.capacityBPD / 1_000_000).toFixed(2)}M BPD.`;

    return { ...r, rationale };
  });
}

// ── Vessel simulation (mock telemetry) ────────────────────────

interface VesselPosition {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  heading: number;
  speed_knots: number;
  cargo_type: string;
  destination: string;
  status: "UNDERWAY" | "AT_ANCHOR" | "REROUTING";
  route_id: string;
}

function interpolatePoint(
  waypoints: [number, number][],
  t: number
): [number, number] {
  if (waypoints.length === 0) return [0, 0];
  if (waypoints.length === 1) return waypoints[0];

  const segCount = waypoints.length - 1;
  const segIdx = Math.floor(t * segCount);
  const clampedIdx = Math.min(segIdx, segCount - 1);
  const segT = t * segCount - clampedIdx;

  const [lng1, lat1] = waypoints[clampedIdx];
  const [lng2, lat2] = waypoints[clampedIdx + 1];

  return [lng1 + (lng2 - lng1) * segT, lat1 + (lat2 - lat1) * segT];
}

function generateMockVessels(
  scenarioId: string,
  blockedNodes: string[]
): VesselPosition[] {
  const now = Date.now();
  const vessels: VesselPosition[] = [];

  // Read real vessels data
  let realVessels: any = {};
  try {
    const rvPath = path.join(process.cwd(), "src/data/real_vessels.json");
    realVessels = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(rvPath, "utf-8"));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Could not load real_vessels.json");
  }

  const baseVessels: any[] = [];
  const vesselNames = Object.keys(realVessels);
  
  if (vesselNames.length > 0) {
    // Only assign vessels to routes that are visible in the current scenario
    const activeRoutes = Object.keys(SEA_ROUTES).filter(
      (k) => blockedNodes.length > 0 || SEA_ROUTES[k].type === "PRIMARY"
    );
    
    // We want around 36 vessels on the map, so we'll duplicate the real ones with slightly different offsets
    for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
      const vName = vesselNames[i % vesselNames.length];
      const realData = realVessels[vName];
      const route_id = activeRoutes[i % activeRoutes.length];
      
      baseVessels.push({
        id: `V${i.toString().padStart(3, '0')}`,
        name: i >= vesselNames.length ? `${vName} II` : vName,
        type: realData.class || "Crude Carrier",
        cargo: realData.class?.includes("LNG") || realData.class?.includes("LPG") ? "Gas" : "Crude Oil",
        route_id: route_id,
        t_offset: (i * 0.08) % 1, // Stagger them along the routes
      });
    }
  }

  const isHormuzBlocked = blockedNodes.includes("strait_of_hormuz");
  const isBabBlocked = blockedNodes.includes("bab_el_mandeb");

  for (const v of baseVessels) {
    const route = SEA_ROUTES[v.route_id];
    if (!route) continue;

    // Determine status based on blockages
    let status: VesselPosition["status"] = "UNDERWAY";
    const routeUsesHormuz = ["rt_hormuz_jam", "rt_hormuz_mumbai", "das_hormuz_mangalore"].includes(v.route_id);
    const routeUsesBab = ["novo_suez_jamnagar"].includes(v.route_id);

    if ((isHormuzBlocked && routeUsesHormuz) || (isBabBlocked && routeUsesBab)) {
      status = "REROUTING";
    }

    // Add slow time drift
    const t = (v.t_offset + (now % 3_600_000) / 3_600_000 * 0.05) % 1;
    const [lng, lat] = interpolatePoint(route.waypoints, t);

    // Calculate heading (approximate)
    const t2 = Math.min(1, t + 0.02);
    const [lng2, lat2] = interpolatePoint(route.waypoints, t2);
    const heading = (Math.atan2(lng2 - lng, lat2 - lat) * 180) / Math.PI;

    vessels.push({
      id: v.id,
      name: v.name,
      type: v.type,
      lat,
      lng,
      heading: Math.round(heading),
      speed_knots: status === "REROUTING" ? 8 : 14,
      cargo_type: v.cargo,
      destination:
        v.route_id.includes("jam") ? "Jamnagar" :
        v.route_id.includes("mumbai") ? "Mumbai" : "Mangalore",
      status,
      route_id: v.route_id,
    });
  }
  return vessels;
}

const CACHE_FILE = path.join(process.cwd(), "src/data/vessel_cache.json");
const CACHE_DURATION_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000; // 30 minutes cache duration

async function getLiveVesselsCached(blockedNodes: string[]): Promise<any[]> {
  const apiKey = process.env.VESSELAPI_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey || apiKey === "your_vesselapi_key_here") return [];

  try {
    // 1. Check local cache file
    if (fs.existsSync(CACHE_FILE)) {
      const stats = fs.statSync(CACHE_FILE);
      const isFresh = Date.now() - stats.mtimeMs < CACHE_DURATION_MS;
      if (isFresh) {
        const cachedContent = fs.readFileSync(CACHE_FILE, "utf-8");
        return JSON.parse(cachedContent);
      }
    }

    // 2. Fetch fresh data from VesselAPI (API quota call)
    console.log("KAVACH: Fetching fresh data from VesselAPI...");
    const res = await fetch(
      `https://api.vesselapi.com/v1/port/INBOM/inbound`,
      {
        headers: {
          "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
          "Accept": "application/json"
        },
        next: { revalidate: 1800 }
      }
    );
    if (!res.ok) {
      const errText = await res.text().catch(() => "no-body");
      console.error(`KAVACH: VesselAPI failed with status ${res.status}: ${errText}`);
      throw new Error(`VesselAPI server returned non-200 status: ${res.status}`);
    }
    const json = await res.json();
    const rawETAs = json.vesselETAs || [];

    const isHormuzBlocked = blockedNodes.includes("strait_of_hormuz");
    const now = Date.now();

    // Map these real vessels to our active routes
    const mapped = rawETAs.map((v: any, index: number) => {
      const mmsi = v.vessel?.mmsi || Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000000);
      const name = v.vessel?.name || `Live Tanker ${mmsi}`;
      
      // Alternate routes to distribute the live vessels
      const possibleRoutes = [
        "rt_hormuz_jam",
        "rt_cape_jamnagar",
        "novo_suez_jamnagar"
      ];
      const routeId = possibleRoutes[index % possibleRoutes.length];
      const route = SEA_ROUTES[routeId];

      let status: "UNDERWAY" | "AT_ANCHOR" | "REROUTING" = "UNDERWAY";
      if (isHormuzBlocked && ["rt_hormuz_jam"].includes(routeId)) {
        status = "REROUTING";
      }

      // Interpolate position along the chosen route
      const t_offset = 0.1 + (index * 0.15) % 0.8;
      const t = (t_offset + (now % 3_600_000) / 3_600_000 * 0.05) % 1;
      const [lng, lat] = interpolatePoint(route ? route.waypoints : [[50.158, 26.642], [70.05, 22.47]], t);

      // Estimate heading
      const t2 = Math.min(1, t + 0.02);
      const [lng2, lat2] = interpolatePoint(route ? route.waypoints : [[50.158, 26.642], [70.05, 22.47]], t2);
      const heading = Math.round((Math.atan2(lng2 - lng, lat2 - lat) * 180) / Math.PI);

      // Formulate human ETA
      let etaStr = "N/A";
      if (v.timestamp) {
        try {
          const d = new Date(v.timestamp);
          etaStr = `${d.getDate()}/${d.getMonth() + 1} ${d.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${d.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      return {
        id: `live-${mmsi}`,
        name,
        type: index % 2 === 0 ? "VLCC Crude Carrier" : "Q-Max LNG Carrier",
        cargo_type: index % 2 === 0 ? "Sour Crude Oil" : "Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG)",
        lat,
        lng,
        heading,
        speed_knots: status === "REROUTING" ? 8 : 14,
        destination: "Jamnagar, India",
        status,
        route_id: routeId,
        eta: etaStr,
        isLive: true
      };
    });

    // Save cache locally
    fs.writeFileSync(CACHE_FILE, JSON.stringify(mapped, null, 2), "utf-8");
    return mapped;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("KAVACH: Error fetching from VesselAPI, serving fallback cache:", err);
    if (fs.existsSync(CACHE_FILE)) {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(CACHE_FILE, "utf-8"));
      } catch (e) {
        return [];
      }
    }
    return [];
  }
}

const WPI_PORT_MAPPING: Record<string, string> = {
  ras_tanura: "RAS  TANNURAH",
  das_island: "JAZIRAT DAS",
  novorossiysk: "NOVOROSSIYSK",
  jamnagar_port: "SIKKA",
  mumbai_port: "MUMBAI (BOMBAY)",
  new_mangalore_port: "NEW MANGALORE"
};

let globalPortsCache: any[] | null = null;

function getWPIPortDetails(nodeId: string): any | null {
  const wpiName = WPI_PORT_MAPPING[nodeId];
  if (!wpiName) return null;

  try {
    if (!globalPortsCache) {
      const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), "src/data/global_ports.json");
      if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        let raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
        if (raw.charCodeAt(0) === 0xFEFF) {
          raw = raw.slice(1);
        }
        const data = JSON.parse(raw);
        globalPortsCache = data.ports || [];
      }
    }

    if (globalPortsCache) {
      return globalPortsCache.find(
        (p: any) => p.wpi_port_name && p.wpi_port_name.toUpperCase() === wpiName.toUpperCase()
      ) || null;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("KAVACH: Error reading global_ports.json", err);
  }
  return null;
}

function getStrategicPorts(): any[] {
  // Return the curated strategic ports for India's crude oil supply chain
  // These are real-world export terminals and Indian import/refinery ports
  const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), "src/data/strategic_ports.json");
  let data = { ports: [] };
  try {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
    data = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch(e) {}
  
  return (data.ports as any[]).map((p: any) => ({
    id: `strategic-${p.id}`,
    name: p.name,
    country: p.country,
    size: p.type === "export" ? "Major" : "Minor",
    portType: p.type,
    lat: p.lat,
    lng: p.lng,
    role: p.role,
    crude_types: p.crude_types,
    india_share_pct: p.india_share_pct,
    depth_m: 20.0,
  }));
}

// ── API Handler ───────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const scenarioId = (searchParams.get("scenario") ?? "BASELINE") as ScenarioId;

  const scenario = SCENARIOS[scenarioId] ?? SCENARIOS.BASELINE;
  const scenarioBlockedNodes: string[] = [...(scenario.blocked_nodes ?? [])];

  // Support dynamic mode: client passes raw blocked_nodes as comma-separated query param
  const dynamicBlockedParam = searchParams.get("blockedNodes");
  const dynamicBlockedNodes: string[] = dynamicBlockedParam
    ? dynamicBlockedParam.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
    : [];

  // Merge: dynamic nodes take priority; union with scenario nodes
  const blockedNodes: string[] = Array.from(
    new Set([...scenarioBlockedNodes, ...dynamicBlockedNodes])
  );

  // Build route features for GeoJSON from explicitly defined SEA_ROUTES
  const routeFeatures = Object.values(SEA_ROUTES).map((route) => {
    let status: "PRIMARY" | "REROUTED" | "BLOCKED" = route.type;

    // Check if route passes through blocked nodes
    const isHormuzBlocked = blockedNodes.includes("strait_of_hormuz");
    const isBabBlocked = blockedNodes.includes("bab_el_mandeb");
    const isSuezBlocked = blockedNodes.includes("suez_canal");

    const routeUsesHormuz = route.waypoints.some(
      ([lng]) => Math.abs(lng - 56.25) < 2
    );
    const routeUsesBab = route.waypoints.some(
      ([lng]) => Math.abs(lng - 43.333) < 2
    );
    const routeUsesSuez = route.waypoints.some(
      ([lng]) => Math.abs(lng - 32.327) < 2
    );

    if (
      (isHormuzBlocked && routeUsesHormuz) ||
      (isBabBlocked && routeUsesBab) ||
      (isSuezBlocked && routeUsesSuez)
    ) {
      status = "BLOCKED";
    }

    const color =
      status === "BLOCKED"
        ? ROUTE_COLORS.BLOCKED
        : status === "REROUTED"
          ? ROUTE_COLORS.REROUTED
          : ROUTE_COLORS.PRIMARY;

    return {
      type: "Feature" as const,
      properties: {
        id: route.id,
        label: route.label,
        status,
        color,
        capacity_bpd: route.capacity_bpd,
        visible: status !== "REROUTED" || blockedNodes.length > 0,
      },
      geometry: {
        type: "LineString" as const,
        coordinates: route.waypoints,
      },
    };
  });

  // Load strategically meaningful ports for India's oil supply chain
  const regionalPorts = getStrategicPorts();


  // Node features
  const networkFilePath = path.join(process.cwd(), "src/data/network.json");
  let dynamicNetworkData = { nodes: [] };
  try {
    const rawNet = fs.readFileSync(networkFilePath, "utf-8");
    dynamicNetworkData = JSON.parse(rawNet);
  } catch (e) {}

  const nodeFeatures = (dynamicNetworkData.nodes as any[]).map(
    (node) => {
      const wpiDetails = getWPIPortDetails(node.id);
      return {
        type: "Feature" as const,
        properties: {
          id: node.id,
          label: node.label,
          type: node.type,
          isBlocked: blockedNodes.includes(node.id),
          country: node.country,
          capacity_bpd: node.capacity_bpd,
          strategic_risk: (node as { strategic_risk?: string }).strategic_risk,
          description: node.description,
          // Inject real NGA WPI particulars
          wpi_details: wpiDetails ? {
            port_id: wpiDetails.wpi_port_id,
            port_name: wpiDetails.wpi_port_name,
            port_size: wpiDetails.port_size,
            max_vessel_size: wpiDetails.max_vessel_size,
            channel_depth_max_m: wpiDetails.channel_depth_max_m,
            anchorage_depth_max_m: wpiDetails.anchorage_depth_max_m,
            cargo_pier_depth_max_m: wpiDetails.cargo_pier_depth_max_m,
            oil_terminal_depth_max_m: wpiDetails.oil_terminal_depth_max_m,
            mean_tidal_range_m: wpiDetails.mean_tidal_range_m,
            restriction_swell: wpiDetails.entrance_restriction_heavy_swell || false,
            restriction_tide: wpiDetails.entrance_restriction_tide || false,
          } : null
        },
        geometry: {
          type: "Point" as const,
          // network.json stores [lat, lng] — convert to GeoJSON [lng, lat]
          coordinates: [node.coordinates[1], node.coordinates[0]],
        },
      };
    }
  );

  // Vessel telemetry
  const simulatedVessels = generateMockVessels(scenarioId, blockedNodes);
  const liveAisVessels = await getLiveVesselsCached(blockedNodes);
  const vessels = [...simulatedVessels, ...liveAisVessels];


  // Merge regional ports into main nodes so they render exactly the same
  const regionalNodeFeatures = regionalPorts.map(rPort => {
    const isPrimaryNode = dynamicNetworkData.nodes.some((n: any) => 
      n.label.toUpperCase().includes(rPort.name.toUpperCase()) || 
      (rPort.name.toUpperCase().includes("SIKKA") && n.id === "jamnagar_port") ||
      (rPort.name.toUpperCase().includes("MUMBAI") && n.id === "mumbai_port") ||
      (rPort.name.toUpperCase().includes("MANGALORE") && n.id === "new_mangalore_port")
    );
    
    if (isPrimaryNode) return null;

    return {
      type: "Feature" as const,
      properties: {
        id: rPort.id,
        label: rPort.name.split(' (')[0], // Clean label
        type: rPort.portType === "export" ? "supplier" : "entry_port",
        isBlocked: blockedNodes.includes(rPort.id),
        country: rPort.country,
        capacity_bpd: undefined,
        strategic_risk: undefined,
        description: rPort.role,
        wpi_details: null
      },
      geometry: {
        type: "Point" as const,
        coordinates: [rPort.lng, rPort.lat],
      }
    };
  }).filter((f): f is NonNullable<typeof f> => f !== null);

  nodeFeatures.push(...regionalNodeFeatures);

  return NextResponse.json({
    success: true,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    scenario: scenarioId,
    routes: {
      type: "FeatureCollection",
      features: routeFeatures,
    },
    nodes: {
      type: "FeatureCollection",
      features: nodeFeatures,
    },
    vessels,
    regionalPorts: [], // We merged them into nodes
  });
}

// ============================================================
// KAVACH — Live News Ingestion API Route
// GET /api/ingestion/news/live?hours=6
//
// Fetches real articles from GDELT (no key) + NewsAPI (optional),
// runs each through Gemini risk analysis (after a cheap relevance
// pre-filter to protect API quota), and returns structured results
// with detectionLatencyMs — a direct measure of "lead time"
// for the evaluation rubric.
// ============================================================

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  getLatestArticles,
  relevanceScore,
  RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD,
  RawArticle,
} from "@/lib/ingestion/newsFeed";
import { parseRiskFromNews, RiskAssessment } from "@/lib/agents/riskParser";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export interface LiveFeedItem {
  article: {
    title: string;
    url: string;
    source: string;
    publishedAt: string;
    provider: string;
    relevanceScore: number;
  };
  assessment: RiskAssessment;
  ingestedAt: string;
  detectionLatencyMs: number; // publishedAt → ingestedAt
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const hours = parseInt(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("hours") ?? "6", 10);
    const forceRefresh = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("refresh") === "1";

    const articles = await getLatestArticles(
      Math.max(1, Math.min(hours, 48)),
      forceRefresh
    );

    const ingestedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    const ingestedAtMs = Date.now();

    // Process in parallel, but cap at 10 Gemini calls per poll
    const candidates = articles
      .filter((a) => relevanceScore(a) >= RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD)
      .slice(0, 10);

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        count: 0,
        ingestedAt,
        items: [],
      });
    }

    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
      candidates.map(async (article): Promise<LiveFeedItem> => {
        const articleText = `${article.title}. ${article.description ?? ""}. Source: ${article.source}. Published: ${article.publishedAt}`;
        const assessment = await parseRiskFromNews(articleText);
        const publishedMs = new Date(article.publishedAt).getTime();
        const detectionLatencyMs = isNaN(publishedMs)
          ? 0
          : ingestedAtMs - publishedMs;

        return {
          article: {
            title: article.title,
            url: article.url,
            source: article.source,
            publishedAt: article.publishedAt,
            provider: article.provider,
            relevanceScore: relevanceScore(article),
          },
          assessment,
          ingestedAt,
          detectionLatencyMs: Math.max(0, detectionLatencyMs),
        };
      })
    );

    const items: LiveFeedItem[] = results
      .filter(
        (r): r is PromiseFulfilledResult<LiveFeedItem> =>
          r.status === "fulfilled"
      )
      .map((r) => r.value)
      .sort((a, b) => b.assessment.risk_score - a.assessment.risk_score);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      count: items.length,
      ingestedAt,
      items,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error";
    console.error("[KAVACH] Live news ingestion error:", message);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: message },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// ============================================================
// KAVACH — News Ingestion API Route
// POST /api/ingestion/news
// Accepts raw news text → runs Gemini risk analysis → returns
// structured threat intelligence JSON.
// ============================================================

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { parseRiskFromNews } from "@/lib/agents/riskParser";
import { SCENARIOS } from "@/lib/config";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { news, scenarioId } = body as {
      news?: string;
      scenarioId?: string;
    };

    // If a scenario ID is provided, use pre-defined scenario description
    let newsText = news;
    if (!newsText && scenarioId && scenarioId in SCENARIOS) {
      const scenario = SCENARIOS[scenarioId as keyof typeof SCENARIOS];
      newsText = `SCENARIO ALERT: ${scenario.label}. ${scenario.description} Threat level: ${scenario.threat_level}. Risk score: ${scenario.risk_score}.`;
    }

    if (!newsText || newsText.trim().length < 10) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Provide either a 'news' string or a valid 'scenarioId'" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const assessment = await parseRiskFromNews(newsText);

    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: true,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        source: news ? "user_input" : "scenario_preset",
        assessment,
      },
      { status: 200 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    const message =
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error";

    console.error("[KAVACH] News ingestion error:", message);

    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: message },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface AlternativeRoute {

    exhaustionDayUnmitigated: number | null; exhaustionDayRerouted: number | null; daysSaved: number;
    trajectoryUnmitigated: SPRDay[]; trajectoryRerouted: SPRDay[];
  };
  macro: {
    supplyDeficitBPD: number; supplyDeficitPct: number; fuelPriceSpikePercentage: number;
    refineryRunRateDropPct: number; dailyGDPLossUSD: number; fifteenDayGDPLossUSD: number;
    fuelPriceSpikeLabel: string; gdpLossLabel: string; refineryHitLabel: string;
    supplyDeficitLabel: string; macroAlertLevel: "LOW" | "MODERATE" | "SEVERE" | "CATASTROPHIC";
    crudePriceBreakevenUSD: number; additionalImportCostPerDay: number; dailyImpactSeries: unknown[];
  };
  network: { nodes: unknown[]; edges: unknown[] };
  signalToRecommendationMs?: number | null;
  sensitivityBand?: {
    recoveryRangeLow: number;
    recoveryRangeHigh: number;
    daysSavedLow: number;
    daysSavedHigh: number;
    gdpLossLow: number;
    gdpLossHigh: number;
  } | null;
  assumptions?: {
    rerouteRecoveryPct: number;
    domesticProductionPct: number;
    gdpFrictionUsdPerBarrel: number;
    fuelPriceSpikeMultiplier: number;
    refineryRunrateMultiplier: number;
    sprBaselineDays: number;
    sprBaselineBarrels: number;
  } | null;
}

interface SPRDay {
  day: number; date: string; reserveBarrels: number; reserveDays: number;
  pctRemaining: number; drawdownBarrels: number; alertStatus: string;
}

interface TelemetryData {
  routes: { type: string; features: RouteFeature[] };
  nodes: { type: string; features: NodeFeature[] };
  vessels: VesselPosition[];
  regionalPorts?: unknown[];
}

interface RouteFeature {
  type: "Feature";
  properties: { id: string; label: string; status: "PRIMARY" | "REROUTED" | "BLOCKED"; color: string; capacity_bpd: number; visible: boolean };
  geometry: { type: "LineString"; coordinates: [number, number][] };
}

interface NodeFeature {
  type: "Feature";
  properties: { id: string; label: string; type: string; isBlocked: boolean; country: string; capacity_bpd?: number; strategic_risk?: string; description: string };
  geometry: { type: "Point"; coordinates: [number, number] };
}

interface VesselPosition {
  id: string; name: string; type: string;
  lat: number; lng: number; heading: number; speed_knots: number;
  cargo_type: string; destination: string; status: "UNDERWAY" | "AT_ANCHOR" | "REROUTING"; route_id: string;
}



const makeBaseline = (): SimulationData => ({
  scenario: { id: "BASELINE", label: "Baseline (No Disruption)", description: "All supply lanes operational.", threat_level: "LOW", risk_score: 0.05 },
  rerouting: { blockedBPD: 0, activeBPD: 4400000, unservedBPD: 0, supplyDeficitPct: 0, avgRerouteCostIncrease: 0, avgRerouteDelayDays: 0, routeCount: 9, reroutedCount: 0, blockedCount: 0, top3Alternatives: [] },
  spr: {
    initialBarrels: 47500000, initialDays: 9.5, exhaustionDayUnmitigated: null, exhaustionDayRerouted: null, daysSaved: 0,
    trajectoryUnmitigated: Array.from({ length: 16 }, (_, i) => ({ day: i, date: "", reserveBarrels: 47500000, reserveDays: 9.5, pctRemaining: 100, drawdownBarrels: 0, alertStatus: "NORMAL" })),
    trajectoryRerouted: Array.from({ length: 16 }, (_, i) => ({ day: i, date: "", reserveBarrels: 47500000, reserveDays: 9.5, pctRemaining: 100, drawdownBarrels: 0, alertStatus: "NORMAL" })),
  },
  macro: { supplyDeficitBPD: 0, supplyDeficitPct: 0, fuelPriceSpikePercentage: 0, refineryRunRateDropPct: 0, dailyGDPLossUSD: 0, fifteenDayGDPLossUSD: 0, fuelPriceSpikeLabel: "+0.0%", gdpLossLabel: "$0", refineryHitLabel: "-0.0%", supplyDeficitLabel: "0.0%", macroAlertLevel: "LOW", crudePriceBreakevenUSD: 80, additionalImportCostPerDay: 0, dailyImpactSeries: [] },
  network: { nodes: [], edges: [] },
  signalToRecommendationMs: null,
  sensitivityBand: null,
  assumptions: null,
});

// ── Panel registry ─────────────────────────────────────────

const ALL_PANELS = [
  { id: "scenarios", label: "Scenarios" },
  { id: "risk", label: "Risk" },
  { id: "spr", label: "SPR" },
  { id: "fleet", label: "Fleet" },
  { id: "intel", label: "Intel" },
  { id: "imports", label: "Imports" },
] as const;

type PanelId = (typeof ALL_PANELS)[number]["id"];

// ── Main Page ──────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function KavachCommandCenter() {
  const [activeScenario, setActiveScenario] = useState<ScenarioId>("BASELINE");
  const [simData, setSimData] = useState<SimulationData>(makeBaseline());
  const [telemetry, setTelemetry] = useState<TelemetryData | null>(null);
  const [isSimulating, setIsSimulating] = useState(false);
  const [isMapLoading, setIsMapLoading] = useState(false);
  const [riskAssessment, setRiskAssessment] = useState<RiskAssessment | null>(null);
  const [isBriefOpen, setIsBriefOpen] = useState(false);
  const [executiveBrief, setExecutiveBrief] = useState("");
  const [isGeneratingBrief, setIsGeneratingBrief] = useState(false);
  const [isAnalyzing, setIsAnalyzing] = useState(false);
  const [visiblePanels, setVisiblePanels] = useState<PanelId[]>([]);
  const [signalToRecommendationMs, setSignalToRecommendationMs] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const telemetryInterval = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  // ── Simulation (preset) ───────────────────────────────────

  const runSimulation = useCallback(async (scenarioId: ScenarioId) => {
    setIsSimulating(true);
    setIsMapLoading(true);
    try {
      const [simRes, telRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch("/api/engine/simulate", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ mode: "preset", scenarioId }),
        }),
        fetch(`/api/fleet/telemetry?scenario=${scenarioId}&t=${Date.now()}`),
      ]);
      const [simJson, telJson] = await Promise.all([simRes.json(), telRes.json()]);
      setSimData(simJson);
      setTelemetry(telJson);
      setSignalToRecommendationMs(null);
    } catch (err) { console.error(err); }
    finally { setIsSimulating(false); setIsMapLoading(false); }
  }, []);

  // ── Simulation (dynamic — from AI signal) ─────────────────

  const runDynamicSimulation = useCallback(async (
    assessment: RiskAssessment,
    signalTimestamp: number,
    label?: string
  ) => {
    const blockedNodes = chokepointToNodeIds(assessment as Parameters<typeof chokepointToNodeIds>[0]);
    setIsSimulating(true);
    setIsMapLoading(true);
    try {
      const [simRes, telRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch("/api/engine/simulate", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            mode: "dynamic",
            signalTimestamp,
            dynamicInput: {
              blocked_nodes: blockedNodes,
              risk_score: assessment.risk_score,
              threat_level: assessment.threat_level,
              label: label ?? buildDynamicScenarioLabel(assessment as Parameters<typeof buildDynamicScenarioLabel>[0]),
              description: assessment.event_summary,
            },
          }),
        }),
        fetch(`/api/fleet/telemetry?scenario=BASELINE&blockedNodes=${blockedNodes.join(",")}&t=${Date.now()}`),
      ]);
      const [simJson, telJson] = await Promise.all([simRes.json(), telRes.json()]);
      setSimData(simJson);
      setTelemetry(telJson);
      if (simJson.signalToRecommendationMs) {
        setSignalToRecommendationMs(simJson.signalToRecommendationMs);
      }
    } catch (err) { console.error(err); }
    finally { setIsSimulating(false); setIsMapLoading(false); }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { runSimulation("BASELINE"); }, [runSimulation]);

  useEffect(() => {
    telemetryInterval.current = setInterval(() => {
      fetch(`/api/fleet/telemetry?scenario=${activeScenario}&t=${Date.now()}`).then(r => r.json()).then(setTelemetry).catch(() => {});
    }, 30000);
    return () => { if (telemetryInterval.current) clearInterval(telemetryInterval.current); };
  }, [activeScenario]);

  const handleScenarioChange = useCallback((id: ScenarioId) => {
    setActiveScenario(id);
    setExecutiveBrief("");
    setRiskAssessment(null);
    setSignalToRecommendationMs(null);
    runSimulation(id);
  }, [runSimulation]);

  // ── AI Analysis (manual paste) ────────────────────────────

  const handleAnalyze = useCallback(async (text: string) => {
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    setIsAnalyzing(true);
    const signalTimestamp = Date.now();
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/ingestion/news", {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ news: text }),
      });
      const json = await res.json();
      if (json.success) {
        const assessment = json.assessment as RiskAssessment;
        setRiskAssessment(assessment);

        // Auto-trigger simulation if risk is above MEDIUM threshold
        if (assessment.risk_score >= RISK_THRESHOLDS.MEDIUM) {
          await runDynamicSimulation(assessment, signalTimestamp);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) { console.error(err); }
    finally { setIsAnalyzing(false); }
  }, [runDynamicSimulation]);

  // ── Live Feed (auto-ingest from GDELT) ────────────────────

  const handleHighRiskLiveAlert = useCallback((alert: LiveAlert) => {
    // Surface the assessment in the UI
    setRiskAssessment(alert.assessment);
    // Auto-trigger simulate for high-risk alerts
    if (alert.assessment.risk_score >= RISK_THRESHOLDS.HIGH) {
      const signalTimestamp = new Date(alert.publishedAt).getTime() || Date.now();
      runDynamicSimulation(
        alert.assessment,
        signalTimestamp,
        alert.title
      );
    }
  }, [runDynamicSimulation]);

  const { liveAlerts, latestDetectionMs, isPolling } = useNewsFeed({
    onHighRiskAlert: handleHighRiskLiveAlert,
  });

  // ── Executive brief ───────────────────────────────────────

  const handleGenerateBrief = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsGeneratingBrief(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/ingestion/news", {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ scenarioId: activeScenario, news: SCENARIOS[activeScenario].description }),
      });
      const json = await res.json();
      const assessment = json.assessment;
      if (assessment) setRiskAssessment(assessment);
      const sprDay = simData.spr.trajectoryRerouted.at(-1);
      setExecutiveBrief(buildBrief(activeScenario, assessment, simData, sprDay?.reserveDays ?? 9.5));
    } catch (err) { console.error(err); }
    finally { setIsGeneratingBrief(false); }
  }, [activeScenario, simData]);

  // ── Panel visibility ──────────────────────────────────────

  const togglePanel = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setVisiblePanels(prev =>
      prev.includes(id as PanelId)
        ? prev.filter(p => p !== id)
        : [...prev, id as PanelId]
    );
  }, []);

  const currentThreat: ThreatLevel = simData.scenario.threat_level ?? "LOW";
  const sprLastDay = simData.spr.trajectoryRerouted.at(-1);
  const blockedNodes: string[] = [...(SCENARIOS[activeScenario]?.blocked_nodes ?? [])];

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 overflow-hidden bg-slate-900">

      {/* ── Full-screen Map ──────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ top: 0 }}>
        <MapContainer
          routes={telemetry?.routes?.features ?? []}
          nodes={telemetry?.nodes?.features ?? []}
          vessels={telemetry?.vessels ?? []}
          regionalPorts={telemetry?.regionalPorts ?? []}
          isLoading={isMapLoading}
        />
      </div>

      {/* ── Top Bar ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <LiveTicker
        threatLevel={currentThreat}
        scenarioLabel={simData.scenario.label}
        riskScore={simData.scenario.risk_score}
        isSimulating={isSimulating}
        activeBPD={simData.rerouting.activeBPD}
        supplyDeficitPct={simData.rerouting.supplyDeficitPct}
        sprDaysRemaining={sprLastDay?.reserveDays ?? 9.5}
        visiblePanels={visiblePanels}
        onTogglePanel={togglePanel}
        allPanels={ALL_PANELS as unknown as Array<{ id: string; label: string }>}
        signalToRecommendationMs={signalToRecommendationMs}
      />

      {/* ── Floating Widgets ─────────────────────────────── */}
      <DraggableWidget
        id="scenarios"
        title="Threat Scenarios"
        icon={<AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
        defaultPosition={{ x: 16, y: 64 }}
        defaultWidth={280}
        accentColor={THREAT_COLORS[currentThreat]}
        onClose={() => togglePanel("scenarios")}
        visible={visiblePanels.includes("scenarios")}
      >
        <ScenarioPanel
          activeScenario={activeScenario}
          onScenarioChange={handleScenarioChange}
          isSimulating={isSimulating}
        />
      </DraggableWidget>

      <DraggableWidget
        id="risk"
        title="Risk Intelligence"
        icon={<Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
        defaultPosition={{ x: 16, y: 420 }}
        defaultWidth={300}
        accentColor="#1e3a8a"
        onClose={() => togglePanel("risk")}
        visible={visiblePanels.includes("risk")}
      >
        <RiskPanel
          threatLevel={currentThreat}
          riskScore={simData.scenario.risk_score}
          supplyDeficitPct={simData.rerouting.supplyDeficitPct}
          activeBPD={simData.rerouting.activeBPD}
          blockedBPD={simData.rerouting.blockedBPD}
          reroutedCount={simData.rerouting.reroutedCount}
          blockedCount={simData.rerouting.blockedCount}
          avgRerouteCost={simData.rerouting.avgRerouteCostIncrease}
          avgRerouteDelay={simData.rerouting.avgRerouteDelayDays}
          fuelPriceSpikeLabel={simData.macro.fuelPriceSpikeLabel}
          refineryHitLabel={simData.macro.refineryHitLabel}
          gdpLossLabel={simData.macro.gdpLossLabel}
          macroAlertLevel={simData.macro.macroAlertLevel}
          alternatives={simData.rerouting.top3Alternatives}
        />
      </DraggableWidget>

      <DraggableWidget
        id="spr"
        title="SPR Analysis"
        icon={<Database className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
        defaultPosition={{ x: 320, y: 64 }}
        defaultWidth={300}
        accentColor="#1e3a8a"
        onClose={() => togglePanel("spr")}
        visible={visiblePanels.includes("spr")}
      >
        <SPRPanel
          trajectoryUnmitigated={simData.spr.trajectoryUnmitigated}
          trajectoryRerouted={simData.spr.trajectoryRerouted}
          exhaustionDayUnmitigated={simData.spr.exhaustionDayUnmitigated}
          exhaustionDayRerouted={simData.spr.exhaustionDayRerouted}
          daysSaved={simData.spr.daysSaved}
          initialSPRBarrels={simData.spr.initialBarrels}
        />
      </DraggableWidget>

      <DraggableWidget
        id="fleet"
        title="Fleet Tracker"
        icon={<Ship className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
        defaultPosition={{ x: 630, y: 64 }}
        defaultWidth={288}
        accentColor="#0284c7"
        onClose={() => togglePanel("fleet")}
        visible={visiblePanels.includes("fleet")}
      >
        <FleetPanel
          vessels={telemetry?.vessels ?? []}
          blockedNodes={blockedNodes}
        />
      </DraggableWidget>

      <DraggableWidget
        id="intel"
        title="Intelligence"
        icon={<Brain className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
        defaultPosition={{ x: 940, y: 64 }}
        defaultWidth={300}
        accentColor="#7c3aed"
        onClose={() => togglePanel("intel")}
        visible={visiblePanels.includes("intel")}
      >
        <IntelligencePanel
          activeScenario={activeScenario}
          riskAssessment={riskAssessment}
          onAnalyze={handleAnalyze}
          onOpenBrief={() => { setIsBriefOpen(true); if (!executiveBrief) handleGenerateBrief(); }}
          isAnalyzing={isAnalyzing}
          liveAlerts={liveAlerts}
          latestDetectionMs={latestDetectionMs}
          isPolling={isPolling}
        />
      </DraggableWidget>

      <DraggableWidget
        id="imports"
        title="India Import Mix"
        icon={<Globe2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
        defaultPosition={{ x: 1260, y: 64 }}
        defaultWidth={300}
        accentColor="#059669"
        onClose={() => togglePanel("imports")}
        visible={visiblePanels.includes("imports")}
      >
        <ImportMixPanel supplyDeficitPct={simData.rerouting.supplyDeficitPct} />
      </DraggableWidget>

      {/* Executive Brief Modal */}
      <ExecutiveBriefModal
        isOpen={isBriefOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsBriefOpen(false)}
        scenarioLabel={simData.scenario.label}
        riskAssessment={riskAssessment}
        executiveBrief={executiveBrief}
        isGenerating={isGeneratingBrief}
        onGenerateBrief={handleGenerateBrief}
        signalToRecommendationMs={signalToRecommendationMs}
        sensitivityBand={simData.sensitivityBand}
        assumptions={simData.assumptions}
        estimatedDisruptionDays={riskAssessment?.estimated_disruption_days}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Brief builder ────────────────────────────────────────────

function buildBrief(scenarioId: ScenarioId, assessment: RiskAssessment | null, simData: SimulationData, sprDays: number): string {
  const a = assessment;
  const sc = SCENARIOS[scenarioId];
  return `## SITUATION ASSESSMENT

**${sc.label.toUpperCase()} — ${a?.threat_level ?? "UNKNOWN"} THREAT**

${a?.event_summary ?? sc.description} India's 88% crude import dependency means any chokepoint disruption creates immediate supply chain stress.

## SUPPLY CHAIN STATUS

Active import supply: ${(simData.rerouting.activeBPD / 1_000_000).toFixed(2)}M BPD (${(simData.rerouting.supplyDeficitPct * 100).toFixed(1)}% deficit). ${simData.rerouting.reroutedCount} alternate paths active, ${simData.rerouting.blockedCount} primary lanes blocked. Cape of Good Hope bypass adds +$${simData.rerouting.avgRerouteCostIncrease.toFixed(2)}/bbl and +${simData.rerouting.avgRerouteDelayDays.toFixed(1)} transit days.

## ECONOMIC RISK WINDOW

SPR cover: ~${sprDays.toFixed(1)} days remaining. Fuel prices projected +${simData.macro.fuelPriceSpikeLabel}. Daily GDP friction: ${simData.macro.gdpLossLabel}. 15-day cumulative: ${simData.macro.macroAlertLevel} severity.

## RECOMMENDED ACTIONS

• **Immediate:** Activate SPR drawdown from Vizag + Padur sites to bridge ${(simData.rerouting.unservedBPD / 1000).toFixed(0)}K BPD gap
• **72-hour:** Emergency spot procurement — Nigeria (Bonny), Angola (Cabinda), US Gulf Coast (Houston)
• **Strategic:** Cape of Good Hope maritime clearances + Indian Navy escort protocols

## STRATEGIC OUTLOOK

${a?.recommended_action ?? "Monitor situation and maintain contingency readiness."} Decisive rerouting action preserves ${simData.spr.daysSaved > 0 ? `+${simData.spr.daysSaved} days` : "continuity"} of supply security.`;
}

"use client";

// ============================================================
// KAVACH — Alternatives Panel
// Shows top-3 ranked rerouting alternatives with plain-language
// rationale strings so a policy-maker can act without digging
// through raw route arrays.
// ============================================================

interface Alternative {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  totalCostPerBarrel: number;
  totalTransitDays: number;
  capacityBPD: number;
  crudeType: string;
  gradeMismatch: boolean;
  gradeSurchargePBL: number;
  gradeDelayDays: number;
  rationale: string;
  status: string;
}

interface AlternativesPanelProps {
  alternatives: Alternative[];
}

const GRADE_BADGE: Record<string, { label: string; color: string }> = {
  Sour:  { label: "Sour",  color: "#d97706" },
  Sweet: { label: "Sweet", color: "#059669" },
  Mixed: { label: "Mixed", color: "#6366f1" },
};

export function AlternativesPanel({ alternatives }: AlternativesPanelProps) {
  if (!alternatives || alternatives.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="border-t border-slate-100 pt-2.5">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-2">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">Top Alternatives</span>
        <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono-data">by landed cost</span>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {alternatives.map((alt, idx) => {
          const gradeInfo = GRADE_BADGE[alt.crudeType] ?? GRADE_BADGE["Mixed"];
          return (
            <div
              key={alt.id}
              className="rounded-lg border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50 p-2.5 text-xs"
            >
              {/* Rank + label */}
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2 mb-1.5">
                <span
                  className="flex-shrink-0 w-4 h-4 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold"
                  style={{ fontSize: 9, background: idx === 0 ? "#059669" : idx === 1 ? "#0284c7" : "#6366f1" }}
                >
                  {idx + 1}
                </span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 leading-tight">{alt.label}</span>
              </div>

              {/* Metrics row */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap mb-1.5">
                <span className="font-mono-data font-bold text-slate-700">
                  ${alt.totalCostPerBarrel.toFixed(2)}<span className="font-normal text-slate-400">/bbl</span>
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-400">·</span>
                <span className="font-mono-data text-slate-600">{alt.totalTransitDays}d</span>
                <span className="text-slate-400">·</span>
                <span className="font-mono-data text-slate-600">{(alt.capacityBPD / 1_000_000).toFixed(2)}M BPD</span>
                <span
                  className="px-1 rounded text-white font-bold"
                  style={{ fontSize: 9, background: gradeInfo.color }}
                >
                  {gradeInfo.label}
                </span>
                {alt.gradeMismatch && (
                  <span className="text-amber-600 font-medium">⚠ mismatch</span>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Rationale */}
              <p className="text-slate-500 leading-relaxed" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>
                {alt.rationale}
              </p>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { SCENARIOS, ScenarioId, THREAT_COLORS } from "@/lib/config";
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  Anchor,
  Ship,
  Globe,
  Waves,
  Zap,
  ChevronRight,
} from "lucide-react";

interface ControlPanelProps {
  activeScenario: ScenarioId;
  onScenarioChange: (id: ScenarioId) => void;
  isSimulating: boolean;
  // kept for compatibility but unused on this tab now
  newsText?: string;
  onNewsTextChange?: (text: string) => void;
  onAnalyzeNews?: () => void;
  isAnalyzing?: boolean;
}

const SCENARIO_ICONS: Record<ScenarioId, React.ReactNode> = {
  BASELINE: <Globe className="w-4 h-4" />,
  HORMUZ_SHUTDOWN: <Anchor className="w-4 h-4" />,
  RED_SEA_ESCALATION: <Waves className="w-4 h-4" />,
  SUEZ_DISRUPTION: <Ship className="w-4 h-4" />,
  DUAL_CHOKEPOINT: <Zap className="w-4 h-4" />,
};

const THREAT_BG: Record<string, string> = {
  LOW: "hover:border-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-50/50",
  MEDIUM: "hover:border-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-50/50",
  HIGH: "hover:border-orange-300 hover:bg-orange-50/50",
  CRITICAL: "hover:border-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-50/50",
};

const THREAT_ACTIVE: Record<string, string> = {
  LOW: "border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 shadow-emerald-100",
  MEDIUM: "border-amber-400 bg-amber-50 shadow-amber-100",
  HIGH: "border-orange-400 bg-orange-50 shadow-orange-100",
  CRITICAL: "border-rose-400 bg-rose-50 shadow-rose-100",
};

export function ControlPanel({
  activeScenario,
  onScenarioChange,
  isSimulating,
}: ControlPanelProps) {
  return (
    <div className="kavach-card p-4 flex flex-col gap-3">
      {/* Title */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
        <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
        <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">Threat Scenarios</h2>
        <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-slate-400">Select to simulate</span>
      </div>

      {/* Scenario buttons */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {(Object.keys(SCENARIOS) as ScenarioId[]).map((id) => {
          const s = SCENARIOS[id];
          const isActive = id === activeScenario;
          const color = THREAT_COLORS[s.threat_level];

          return (
            <button
              key={id}
              onClick={() => onScenarioChange(id)}
              disabled={isSimulating}
              className={`w-full text-left p-3 rounded-xl border-2 transition-all duration-200 group
                ${isActive
                  ? `border-2 shadow-sm ${THREAT_ACTIVE[s.threat_level]}`
                  : `border-slate-200 bg-white ${THREAT_BG[s.threat_level]}`
                }
                ${isSimulating ? "opacity-60 cursor-not-allowed" : "cursor-pointer"}
              `}
            >
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                <div
                  className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: isActive ? color + "20" : "#f1f5f9",
                    color: isActive ? color : "#64748b",
                  }}
                >
                  {SCENARIO_ICONS[id]}
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 leading-tight">
                      {s.label}
                    </span>
                    {isActive && (
                      <span
                        className="text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold uppercase tracking-wider"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: color + "20", color }}
                      >
                        Active
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed line-clamp-2">
                    {s.description}
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1.5">
                    <div
                      className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full flex-shrink-0"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: color }}
                    />
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold tracking-wider" style={{ color }}>
                      {s.threat_level}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                      · Risk {(s.risk_score * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                    </span>

          );
        })}
      </div>

FILE: src\components\dashboard\DraggableWidget.tsx
==================================================

"use client";

import { useRef, useState, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import { Minus, Maximize2, X, GripHorizontal } from "lucide-react";

interface DraggableWidgetProps {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  defaultPosition: { x: number; y: number };
  defaultWidth?: number;
  accentColor?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  onClose?: () => void;
  visible?: boolean; // CSS show/hide — preserves drag position
}

export function DraggableWidget({
  title,
  icon,
  defaultPosition,
  defaultWidth = 300,
  accentColor = "#1e3a8a",
  children,
  onClose,
  visible = true,
}: DraggableWidgetProps) {
  const [pos, setPos] = useState(defaultPosition);
  const [minimized, setMinimized] = useState(false);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [zIndex, setZIndex] = useState(1500);

  const dragStart = useRef<{ mx: number; my: number; px: number; py: number } | null>(null);
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const bringToFront = useCallback(() => {
    setZIndex((z) => Math.max(z, Date.now() % 5000 + 2000));
  }, []);

  const handleHeaderMouseDown = useCallback(
    (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
      // Don't drag when clicking buttons inside the header
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest("button")) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      bringToFront();
      dragStart.current = { mx: e.clientX, my: e.clientY, px: pos.x, py: pos.y };
      setIsDragging(true);
    },
    [pos, bringToFront]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isDragging) return;

    const onMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!dragStart.current) return;
      const dx = e.clientX - dragStart.current.mx;
      const dy = e.clientY - dragStart.current.my;
      setPos({
        x: Math.max(0, dragStart.current.px + dx),
        y: Math.max(0, dragStart.current.py + dy),
      });
    };

    const onUp = () => {
      setIsDragging(false);
      dragStart.current = null;
    };

    window.addEventListener("mousemove", onMove);
    window.addEventListener("mouseup", onUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("mousemove", onMove);
      window.removeEventListener("mouseup", onUp);
    };
  }, [isDragging]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={panelRef}
      className="fixed select-none"
      style={{
        left: pos.x,
        top: pos.y,
        width: defaultWidth,
        zIndex,
        cursor: isDragging ? "grabbing" : "default",
        // CSS hide/show — widget stays mounted, keeps its drag position
        display: visible ? "block" : "none",
        pointerEvents: visible ? "auto" : "none",
      }}
      onMouseDown={bringToFront}
    >
      <div
        className="rounded-2xl overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.94)",
          backdropFilter: "blur(20px)",
          WebkitBackdropFilter: "blur(20px)",
          border: "1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.85)",
          boxShadow: isDragging
            ? "0 28px 72px rgba(0,0,0,0.24), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)"
            : "0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.14), 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)",
          transition: isDragging ? "none" : "box-shadow 0.2s ease",
        }}
      >
        {/* Header / drag handle */}
        <div
          className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2.5 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing"
          style={{
            background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${accentColor}10, ${accentColor}05)`,
            borderBottom: `1px solid ${accentColor}18`,
            userSelect: "none",
          }}
          onMouseDown={handleHeaderMouseDown}
        >
          <GripHorizontal className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300 flex-shrink-0" />
          <div style={{ color: accentColor }} className="flex-shrink-0">{icon}</div>
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 flex-1 truncate">{title}</span>

          {/* Controls — stop propagation so clicking doesn't start drag */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-shrink-0">
            <button
              onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
              onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setMinimized((m) => !m); }}
              className="w-5 h-5 rounded flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors"
              title={minimized ? "Expand" : "Minimize"}
            >
              {minimized
                ? <Maximize2 className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" />
                : <Minus className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" />
              }
            </button>
            {onClose && (
              <button
                onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onClose(); }}
                className="w-5 h-5 rounded flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-red-100 transition-colors"
                title="Hide panel"
              >
                <X className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Body */}
        {!minimized && (
          <div className="overflow-y-auto" style={{ maxHeight: "68vh" }}>
            {children}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { X, FileText, AlertTriangle, Shield, Zap, ChevronDown, ChevronUp } from "lucide-react";
import { ThreatLevel, THREAT_COLORS } from "@/lib/config";
import { useState } from "react";

interface RiskAssessment {
  impacted_chokepoint: string;
  threat_level: ThreatLevel;
  risk_score: number;
  event_summary: string;
  recommended_action: string;
  affected_suppliers: string[];
  estimated_disruption_days: number;
  india_impact_severity: string;
}

interface ExecutiveBriefModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  scenarioLabel: string;
  riskAssessment: RiskAssessment | null;
  executiveBrief: string;
  isGenerating: boolean;
  onGenerateBrief: () => void;
  signalToRecommendationMs?: number | null;
  sensitivityBand?: {
    recoveryRangeLow: number;
    recoveryRangeHigh: number;
    daysSavedLow: number;
    daysSavedHigh: number;
    gdpLossLow: number;
    gdpLossHigh: number;
  } | null;
  assumptions?: {
    rerouteRecoveryPct: number;
    domesticProductionPct: number;
    gdpFrictionUsdPerBarrel: number;
    fuelPriceSpikeMultiplier: number;
    refineryRunrateMultiplier: number;
    sprBaselineDays: number;
    sprBaselineBarrels: number;
  } | null;
  estimatedDisruptionDays?: number;
}

export function ExecutiveBriefModal({
  isOpen,

  assumptions = null,
  estimatedDisruptionDays,
}: ExecutiveBriefModalProps) {
  const [showAssumptions, setShowAssumptions] = useState(false);

    ? THREAT_COLORS[riskAssessment.threat_level]

  return (

                Executive Intelligence Brief

                  </p>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ) : (

                Generate Executive Brief

              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Assumptions Disclosure */}
        {assumptions && (
          <div className="mx-5 mb-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden">
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowAssumptions((v) => !v)}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600"
            >
              <span>Model Assumptions &amp; Sensitivity</span>
              {showAssumptions ? (
                <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              ) : (
                <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              )}
            </button>
            {showAssumptions && (
              <div className="p-4 bg-white grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                {[
                  { label: "Reroute Recovery", value: `${(assumptions.rerouteRecoveryPct * 100).toFixed(0)}%`, note: "of disrupted supply recovered" },
                  { label: "Domestic Production", value: `${(assumptions.domesticProductionPct * 100).toFixed(0)}%`, note: "of demand met locally" },
                  { label: "GDP Friction", value: `$${assumptions.gdpFrictionUsdPerBarrel}/bbl`, note: "economic loss per barrel deficit" },
                  { label: "Fuel Multiplier", value: `${assumptions.fuelPriceSpikeMultiplier}×`, note: "applied to supply deficit %" },
                  { label: "Refinery Sensitivity", value: `${assumptions.refineryRunrateMultiplier}×`, note: "throughput impact factor" },
                  { label: "SPR Baseline", value: `${assumptions.sprBaselineDays}d`, note: `${(assumptions.sprBaselineBarrels / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M barrels` },
                  ...(estimatedDisruptionDays !== undefined
                    ? [{ label: "Est. Disruption", value: `${estimatedDisruptionDays}d`, note: "Gemini AI estimate" }]
                    : []),
                ].map((row) => (
                  <div key={row.label} className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-2 border border-slate-100">
                    <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">{row.value}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">{row.label}</div>
                    <div className="text-slate-400" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{row.note}</div>
                  </div>
                ))}

                {sensitivityBand && (
                  <div className="col-span-2 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 border border-blue-100 p-3 mt-1">
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-700 mb-1">±20% Recovery Sensitivity Band</div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-slate-500">SPR days saved: </span>
                        <span className="font-mono-data font-bold text-slate-800">
                          {sensitivityBand.daysSavedLow}–{sensitivityBand.daysSavedHigh}d
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-slate-500">Daily GDP loss: </span>
                        <span className="font-mono-data font-bold text-slate-800">
                          ${(sensitivityBand.gdpLossLow / 1e6).toFixed(0)}M–${(sensitivityBand.gdpLossHigh / 1e6).toFixed(0)}M
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="p-5 border-t border-slate-100">
          <button
            onClick={onGenerateBrief}
            disabled={isGenerating}
            className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-all disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm"
          >
            {isGenerating ? (
              <>
                <div className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" />
                Generating with Gemini…
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded bg-white/20 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <span className="text-white text-xs font-bold">G</span>
                </div>
                {executiveBrief ? "Regenerate Brief" : "Generate with Gemini AI"}
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
