"use client";

import { AreaChart, Area, XAxis, YAxis, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, ReferenceLine } from "recharts";
import { TrendingDown, Database } from "lucide-react";

interface SPRDayPoint {
  day: number;
  reserveBarrels: number;
  pctRemaining: number;
  alertStatus: string;
}

interface SPRPanelProps {
  trajectoryUnmitigated: SPRDayPoint[];
  trajectoryRerouted: SPRDayPoint[];
  exhaustionDayUnmitigated: number | null;
  exhaustionDayRerouted: number | null;
  daysSaved: number;
  initialSPRBarrels: number;
}

// SPR site breakdown (static)
const SPR_SITES = [
  { name: "Padur, Karnataka", capacity: 26.5, fill: 92 },
  { name: "Mangalore, Karnataka", capacity: 11.25, fill: 88 },
  { name: "Vizag, Andhra Pradesh", capacity: 9.75, fill: 95 },
];

function formatM(v: number) {
  return `${(v / 1_000_000).toFixed(0)}M`;
}

function MiniTooltip({ active, payload, label }: { active?: boolean; payload?: Array<{ name: string; value: number; color: string }>; label?: string }) {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null;
  return (
    <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-md p-2 text-xs">
      <p className="font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">Day {label}</p>
      {payload.map((p) => (
        <div key={p.name} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ background: p.color }} />
          <span className="text-slate-600">{p.name === "unmitigated" ? "No action" : "Rerouted"}:</span>
          <span className="font-bold font-mono-data">{formatM(p.value)}</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function SPRPanel({
  trajectoryUnmitigated,
  trajectoryRerouted,
  exhaustionDayUnmitigated,
  exhaustionDayRerouted,
  daysSaved,
  initialSPRBarrels,
}: SPRPanelProps) {
  const chartData = trajectoryUnmitigated.map((u, i) => ({
    day: u.day,
    unmitigated: u.reserveBarrels,
    rerouted: trajectoryRerouted[i]?.reserveBarrels ?? 0,
  }));

  const warningLine = initialSPRBarrels * 0.15;
  const totalSPR = SPR_SITES.reduce((s, x) => s + x.capacity, 0);

  return (
    <div className="p-3 flex flex-col gap-3">
      {/* SPR site breakdown */}
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-2">
          <Database className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">SPR Sites</span>
          <span className="ml-auto text-xs font-bold font-mono-data text-blue-700">{totalSPR.toFixed(1)}M bbl total</span>
        </div>
        {SPR_SITES.map((site) => (
          <div key={site.name} className="mb-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-600">{site.name}</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-mono-data font-bold text-slate-700">
                {((site.capacity * site.fill) / 100).toFixed(1)}M / {site.capacity}M bbl
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="w-full h-2 bg-slate-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-700"
                style={{
                  width: `${site.fill}%`,
                  background: site.fill > 85 ? "#22c55e" : site.fill > 60 ? "#f59e0b" : "#e11d48",
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5 text-right">{site.fill}% full</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Key stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
        {[
          {
            label: "No-Action Exhaust",
            value: exhaustionDayUnmitigated != null ? `Day ${exhaustionDayUnmitigated}` : ">15d",
            color: exhaustionDayUnmitigated != null ? "#e11d48" : "#22c55e",
          },
          {
            label: "With Rerouting",
            value: exhaustionDayRerouted != null ? `Day ${exhaustionDayRerouted}` : ">15d ✓",
            color: exhaustionDayRerouted != null ? "#f59e0b" : "#22c55e",
          },
        ].map((s) => (
          <div key={s.label} className="rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 p-2 text-center">
            <div className="text-sm font-extrabold font-mono-data" style={{ color: s.color }}>{s.value}</div>
            <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">{s.label}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {daysSaved > 0 && (
        <div className="rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 p-2 flex items-center gap-2">
          <TrendingDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span className="text-xs text-emerald-700 font-semibold">
            Rerouting adds +{daysSaved} days of SPR cover
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mini chart */}
      <div>
        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1.5">15-Day Drawdown</p>
        <div style={{ height: 110 }}>
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <AreaChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 4, right: 4, left: -20, bottom: 0 }}>
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="spu" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#e11d48" stopOpacity={0.15} />
                  <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#e11d48" stopOpacity={0.01} />
                </linearGradient>
                <linearGradient id="spr" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                  <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#10b981" stopOpacity={0.15} />
                  <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#10b981" stopOpacity={0.01} />
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>
              <XAxis dataKey="day" tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: "#94a3b8" }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} />
              <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 9, fill: "#94a3b8" }} tickFormatter={formatM} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} width={30} />
              <Tooltip content={<MiniTooltip />} />
              <ReferenceLine y={warningLine} stroke="#f59e0b" strokeDasharray="3 2" strokeWidth={1} />
              <Area type="monotone" dataKey="unmitigated" name="unmitigated" stroke="#e11d48" strokeWidth={1.5} fill="url(#spu)" dot={false} />
              <Area type="monotone" dataKey="rerouted" name="rerouted" stroke="#10b981" strokeWidth={1.5} fill="url(#spr)" dot={false} />
            </AreaChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src\hooks\useNewsFeed.ts

"use client";

// ============================================================
// KAVACH — useNewsFeed hook
// Polls /api/ingestion/news/live every 5 minutes and surfaces
// high-risk articles as live alerts in the dashboard.
// ============================================================

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import type { RiskAssessment } from "@/lib/agents/riskParser";
import { RISK_THRESHOLDS } from "@/lib/config";

// ── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface LiveAlert {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  url: string;
  source: string;
  publishedAt: string;
  provider: string;
  relevanceScore: number;
  assessment: RiskAssessment;
  ingestedAt: string;
  detectionLatencyMs: number;
}

interface UseNewsFeedOptions {
  pollIntervalMs?: number;  // default 5 minutes
  hoursBack?: number;       // default 6h window
  minRiskScore?: number;    // default RISK_THRESHOLDS.MEDIUM
  onHighRiskAlert?: (alert: LiveAlert) => void;
}

interface UseNewsFeedReturn {
  liveAlerts: LiveAlert[];
  latestDetectionMs: number | null;
  isPolling: boolean;
  lastPollAt: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  pollNow: () => void;
}

// ── Hook ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function useNewsFeed({
  pollIntervalMs = 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes
  hoursBack = 6,
  minRiskScore = RISK_THRESHOLDS.MEDIUM,
  onHighRiskAlert,
}: UseNewsFeedOptions = {}): UseNewsFeedReturn {
  const [liveAlerts, setLiveAlerts] = useState<LiveAlert[]>([]);
  const [latestDetectionMs, setLatestDetectionMs] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [isPolling, setIsPolling] = useState(false);
  const [lastPollAt, setLastPollAt] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Track seen article URLs to avoid re-firing onHighRiskAlert
  const seenUrls = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const intervalRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  const poll = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsPolling(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/ingestion/news/live?hours=${hoursBack}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const json = await res.json();

      if (!json.success) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Unknown feed error");

      const items: Array<{
        article: {
          title: string;
          url: string;
          source: string;
          publishedAt: string;
          provider: string;
          relevanceScore: number;
        };
        assessment: RiskAssessment;
        ingestedAt: string;
        detectionLatencyMs: number;
      }> = json.items ?? [];

      // Filter to high-risk alerts
      const highRisk = items.filter(
        (item) => item.assessment.risk_score >= minRiskScore
      );

      const newAlerts: LiveAlert[] = highRisk.map((item) => ({
        id: `${item.article.url}_${item.ingestedAt}`,
        ...item.article,
        assessment: item.assessment,
        ingestedAt: item.ingestedAt,
        detectionLatencyMs: item.detectionLatencyMs,
      }));

      // Only add truly new alerts (not seen before)
      const freshAlerts = newAlerts.filter(
        (a) => !seenUrls.current.has(a.url)
      );

      if (freshAlerts.length > 0) {
        freshAlerts.forEach((a) => seenUrls.current.add(a.url));
        setLiveAlerts((prev) =>
          [...freshAlerts, ...prev].slice(0, 20) // cap at 20 alerts
        );

        // Fire callbacks for brand-new high-risk alerts
        if (onHighRiskAlert) {
          freshAlerts.forEach((a) => onHighRiskAlert(a));
        }
      }

      // Track best (lowest) detection latency from this batch
      const latencies = items.map((i) => i.detectionLatencyMs).filter((l) => l > 0);
      if (latencies.length > 0) {
        setLatestDetectionMs(Math.min(...latencies));
      }

      setLastPollAt(new Date().toISOString());
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Feed error";
      console.error("[KAVACH] useNewsFeed poll error:", msg);
      setError(msg);
    } finally {
      setIsPolling(false);
    }
  }, [hoursBack, minRiskScore, onHighRiskAlert]);

  // Initial poll on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    poll();
  }, [poll]);

  // Recurring polling
  useEffect(() => {
    intervalRef.current = setInterval(poll, pollIntervalMs);
    return () => {
      if (intervalRef.current) clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
    };
  }, [poll, pollIntervalMs]);

  return {
    liveAlerts,
    latestDetectionMs,
    isPolling,
    lastPollAt,
    error,
    pollNow: poll,
  };
}

FILE: src\lib\agents\riskParser.ts
==================================================

// ============================================================
// KAVACH — Gemini Risk Intelligence Agent
// Processes raw news/scenario text and returns structured
// JSON threat assessment using Google Gemini API.
// ============================================================

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";
import { GEMINI_MODEL, GEMINI_API_KEY, ThreatLevel } from "@/lib/config";
import networkData from "@/data/network.json";

// ── Supplier node list helper ──────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Returns the current list of supplier node labels from network.json.
 * Injected into the Gemini prompt so recommendations are always
 * grounded in the actual graph — never hallucinated.
 */
export function getAvailableSupplierNames(): string[] {
  return (networkData.nodes as Array<{ type: string; label: string }>)
    .filter((n) => n.type === "supplier")
    .map((n) => n.label);
}

// ── Output Schema ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RiskAssessment {
  impacted_chokepoint:
    | "Strait_of_Hormuz"
    | "Bab_el_Mandeb"
    | "Suez_Canal"
    | "Cape_of_Good_Hope"
    | "Multiple"
    | "None";
  threat_level: ThreatLevel;
  risk_score: number; // 0.0 – 1.0
  event_summary: string;
  recommended_action: string;
  affected_suppliers: string[];
  estimated_disruption_days: number;
  india_impact_severity: "MINIMAL" | "MODERATE" | "SEVERE" | "CRISIS";
}

// ── Prompt Template ───────────────────────────────────────────

function buildPrompt(newsText: string, availableSuppliers?: string[]): string {
  const supplierList = availableSuppliers?.join(", ") ??
    "Saudi Arabia (Ras Tanura), UAE (Das Island), Russia (Novorossiysk), Iraq (Basra Terminal), Nigeria (Bonny Terminal), Angola (Cabinda/Nemba Terminal), USA (Houston/Corpus Christi)";

  return `You are KAVACH, an AI risk analyst for India's energy security command center.

Analyze the following news/scenario and extract structured intelligence about its impact on India's crude oil supply chain.

India imports 88% of its crude oil. Key chokepoints:
- Strait of Hormuz: ~42.5% of India's oil transits here
- Bab-el-Mandeb / Red Sea: Alternative route, Houthi threat zone
- Suez Canal: Egypt shortcut, can be blocked
- Cape of Good Hope: Fallback bypass route (+12 days)

Currently modeled suppliers (ONLY use these in your recommendations):
${supplierList}

Main Indian refineries: Jamnagar (Reliance, 1.24M BPD), MRPL Mangalore (300K BPD), IOCL Koyali (274K BPD)

NEWS/SCENARIO:
"""
${newsText}
"""

Return ONLY a valid JSON object matching this exact schema (no markdown, no explanation):
{
  "impacted_chokepoint": "<Strait_of_Hormuz|Bab_el_Mandeb|Suez_Canal|Cape_of_Good_Hope|Multiple|None>",
  "threat_level": "<LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL>",
  "risk_score": <0.0 to 1.0>,
  "event_summary": "<2-3 sentence summary of the event and its direct impact on India>",
  "recommended_action": "<specific actionable recommendation for India's energy ministry, referencing ONLY the suppliers listed above>",
  "affected_suppliers": ["<supplier name from the list above>"],
  "estimated_disruption_days": <integer 0-180>,
  "india_impact_severity": "<MINIMAL|MODERATE|SEVERE|CRISIS>"
}`;
}

// ── Risk Parser Agent ─────────────────────────────────────────

export async function parseRiskFromNews(
  newsText: string
): Promise<RiskAssessment> {
  if (!GEMINI_API_KEY) {
    throw new Error(
      "GEMINI_API_KEY is not set. Add it to your .env.local file."
    );
  }

  const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: GEMINI_API_KEY });

  // Inject live supplier list into prompt
  const availableSuppliers = getAvailableSupplierNames();

  const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
    model: GEMINI_MODEL,
    contents: buildPrompt(newsText, availableSuppliers),
    config: {
      temperature: 0.1, // Low temperature for deterministic structured output
      maxOutputTokens: 1024,
    },
  });

  const rawText = response.text ?? "";

  // Extract JSON from response (handles cases where model adds markdown fences)
  const jsonMatch = rawText.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
  if (!jsonMatch) {
    throw new Error(`Gemini returned non-JSON response: ${rawText}`);
  }

  let parsed: RiskAssessment;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]) as RiskAssessment;
  } catch (e) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to parse Gemini JSON: ${jsonMatch[0]}`);
  }

  // Validate and clamp risk_score
  parsed.risk_score = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, parsed.risk_score ?? 0));

  // Ensure estimated_disruption_days is a number
  if (typeof parsed.estimated_disruption_days !== "number") {
    parsed.estimated_disruption_days = 0;
  }

  return parsed;
}

// ── Executive Brief Generator ─────────────────────────────────

export async function generateExecutiveBrief(params: {
  scenarioId: string;
  riskAssessment: RiskAssessment;
  supplyDeficitPct: number;
  activeBPD: number;
  sprRemainingDays: number;
  avgRerouteCostIncrease: number;
  fuelPriceSpikeLabel: string;
  gdpLossLabel: string;
}): Promise<string> {
  if (!GEMINI_API_KEY) {
    return generateFallbackBrief(params);
  }

  const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: GEMINI_API_KEY });

  const prompt = `You are KAVACH, India's AI energy security analyst. Write a concise, high-stakes executive brief for senior policy makers.

SCENARIO: ${params.scenarioId.replace(/_/g, " ")}
THREAT LEVEL: ${params.riskAssessment.threat_level}
RISK SCORE: ${(params.riskAssessment.risk_score * 100).toFixed(0)}%
IMPACTED CHOKEPOINT: ${params.riskAssessment.impacted_chokepoint.replace(/_/g, " ")}

SUPPLY METRICS:
- Supply Deficit: ${(params.supplyDeficitPct * 100).toFixed(1)}% of daily demand
- Active Supply: ${(params.activeBPD / 1_000_000).toFixed(2)}M BPD flowing
- SPR Cover Remaining: ~${params.sprRemainingDays.toFixed(1)} days
- Rerouting Cost Increase: +$${params.avgRerouteCostIncrease}/barrel

ECONOMIC IMPACT:
- Domestic Fuel Price Spike: ${params.fuelPriceSpikeLabel}
- Daily GDP Loss Estimate: ${params.gdpLossLabel}

AI RECOMMENDED ACTION: ${params.riskAssessment.recommended_action}

Write a 200-250 word executive brief with:
1. SITUATION ASSESSMENT (2-3 sentences)
2. SUPPLY CHAIN STATUS (what's blocked, what's rerouted)
3. ECONOMIC RISK WINDOW (SPR timeline, cost)
4. RECOMMENDED RESPONSE ACTIONS (3 bullet points)
5. STRATEGIC OUTLOOK (1 closing sentence)

Use crisp, ministerial-level language. Be direct and data-driven.`;

  const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
    model: GEMINI_MODEL,
    contents: prompt,
    config: {
      temperature: 0.4,
      maxOutputTokens: 512,
    },
  });

  return response.text ?? generateFallbackBrief(params);
}

**SITUATION ASSESSMENT**

**SUPPLY CHAIN STATUS**
Active import supply stands at ${(params.activeBPD / 1_000_000).toFixed(2)}M BPD — a ${(params.supplyDeficitPct * 100).toFixed(1)}% deficit from baseline demand. **STRATEGIC OUTLOOK**

// ============================================================
// KAVACH — Digital Twin Graph Engine
// Builds a directed graphology graph from network.json
// and provides query utilities for the simulation engine.
// ============================================================

import Graph from "graphology";
import networkData from "@/data/network.json";

// ── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type CrudeType = "Sweet" | "Sour" | "Mixed";

export type NodeType =
  | "supplier"
  | "chokepoint"
  | "entry_port"
  | "refinery";

export interface NetworkNode {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  type: NodeType;
  country: string;
  coordinates: [number, number]; // [lat, lng]
  capacity_bpd?: number;
  crude_type?: CrudeType;
  configured_crude?: CrudeType;
  api_gravity?: number;
  sulfur_pct?: number;
  throughput_bpd?: number;
  strategic_risk?: string;
  nelson_complexity?: number;
  description: string;
}

export interface NetworkEdge {
  id: string;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  distance_nm: number;
  cost_per_barrel: number;
  capacity_bpd: number;
  type: CrudeType;
  transit_days: number;
  is_primary: boolean;
}

export interface GraphEdgeAttributes extends NetworkEdge {
  blocked: boolean;
  effective_cost: number; // includes penalties
}

// ── Digital Twin Class ───────────────────────────────────────

export class DigitalTwin {
  private graph: Graph;
  private nodes: Map<string, NetworkNode>;
  private edges: Map<string, NetworkEdge>;
  private blockedNodes: Set<string>;

  constructor() {
    this.graph = new Graph({ type: "directed", multi: false });
    this.nodes = new Map();
    this.edges = new Map();
    this.blockedNodes = new Set();

    this._initialize();
  }

  private _initialize(): void {
    // Load all nodes
    for (const node of networkData.nodes as NetworkNode[]) {
      this.nodes.set(node.id, node);
      this.graph.addNode(node.id, { ...node });
    }

    // Load all edges
    for (const edge of networkData.edges as NetworkEdge[]) {
      this.edges.set(edge.id, edge);
      this.graph.addDirectedEdge(edge.from, edge.to, {
        ...edge,
        blocked: false,
        effective_cost: edge.cost_per_barrel,
      } as GraphEdgeAttributes);
    }
  }

  // ── Blocking API ──────────────────────────────────────────

  /** Mark nodes as blocked (chokepoint closure) */
  blockNodes(nodeIds: string[]): void {
    this.blockedNodes = new Set(nodeIds);
  }

  /** Clear all blocks */
  clearBlocks(): void {
    this.blockedNodes.clear();
  }

  /** Check if a node is blocked */
  isBlocked(nodeId: string): boolean {
    return this.blockedNodes.has(nodeId);
  }

  // ── Graph Access ─────────────────────────────────────────

  getGraph(): Graph {
    return this.graph;
  }

  getNode(id: string): NetworkNode | undefined {
    return this.nodes.get(id);
  }

  getAllNodes(): NetworkNode[] {
    return Array.from(this.nodes.values());
  }

  getAllEdges(): NetworkEdge[] {
    return Array.from(this.edges.values());
  }

  getBlockedNodes(): Set<string> {
    return new Set(this.blockedNodes);
  }

  getNodesByType(type: NodeType): NetworkNode[] {
    return Array.from(this.nodes.values()).filter((n) => n.type === type);
  }

  // ── Path Utilities ────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Get all outgoing edges from a node, optionally filtering blocked nodes
   */
  getOutEdges(
    nodeId: string,
    excludeBlocked = true
  ): Array<{ edge: NetworkEdge; target: string }> {
    if (!this.graph.hasNode(nodeId)) return [];

    const result: Array<{ edge: NetworkEdge; target: string }> = [];

    this.graph.forEachOutEdge(nodeId, (edgeKey, attrs, source, target) => {
      if (excludeBlocked && this.blockedNodes.has(target)) return;
      const edge = attrs as GraphEdgeAttributes;
      result.push({ edge, target });
    });

    return result;
  }

  /**
   * Compute adjacency list for Dijkstra (excluding blocked nodes)
   */
  buildAdjacencyList(
    excludeBlocked = true
  ): Map<string, Array<{ target: string; edge: NetworkEdge }>> {
    const adj = new Map<
      string,
      Array<{ target: string; edge: NetworkEdge }>
    >();

    this.graph.forEachNode((nodeId) => {
      if (excludeBlocked && this.blockedNodes.has(nodeId)) return;
      adj.set(nodeId, []);
    });

    this.graph.forEachEdge((edgeKey, attrs, source, target) => {
      if (excludeBlocked && this.blockedNodes.has(source)) return;
      if (excludeBlocked && this.blockedNodes.has(target)) return;

      const list = adj.get(source);
      if (list) {
        list.push({ target, edge: attrs as NetworkEdge });
      }
    });

    return adj;
  }

  /**
   * Get suppliers currently reachable to a given port (path exists through unblocked nodes)
   */
  getReachableSuppliers(portId: string): NetworkNode[] {
    const suppliers = this.getNodesByType("supplier");
    return suppliers.filter((s) => {
      const paths = this.dijkstra(s.id, portId);
      return paths !== null && paths.path.length > 0;
    });
  }

  /**
   * Dijkstra shortest path by cost (USD/barrel) between two nodes
   */
  dijkstra(
    sourceId: string,
    targetId: string
  ): { path: string[]; totalCost: number; totalDays: number } | null {
    const adj = this.buildAdjacencyList(true);
    const dist = new Map<string, number>();
    const prev = new Map<string, string | null>();
    const days = new Map<string, number>();
    const unvisited = new Set<string>();

    for (const nodeId of adj.keys()) {
      dist.set(nodeId, Infinity);
      prev.set(nodeId, null);
      days.set(nodeId, 0);
      unvisited.add(nodeId);
    }

    dist.set(sourceId, 0);

    while (unvisited.size > 0) {
      // Find min dist unvisited node
      let u: string | null = null;
      let minDist = Infinity;
      for (const nodeId of unvisited) {
        const d = dist.get(nodeId) ?? Infinity;
        if (d < minDist) {
          minDist = d;
          u = nodeId;
        }
      }

      if (u === null || u === targetId) break;
      unvisited.delete(u);

      const neighbors = adj.get(u) ?? [];
      for (const { target, edge } of neighbors) {
        if (!unvisited.has(target)) continue;
        const alt = (dist.get(u) ?? Infinity) + edge.cost_per_barrel;
        if (alt < (dist.get(target) ?? Infinity)) {
          dist.set(target, alt);
          prev.set(target, u);
          days.set(target, (days.get(u) ?? 0) + edge.transit_days);
        }
      }
    }

    // Reconstruct path
    if ((dist.get(targetId) ?? Infinity) === Infinity) return null;

    const path: string[] = [];
    let cur: string | null = targetId;
    while (cur !== null) {
      path.unshift(cur);
      cur = prev.get(cur) ?? null;
    }

    return {
      path,
      totalCost: dist.get(targetId) ?? Infinity,
      totalDays: days.get(targetId) ?? 0,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get active supply routes: supplier → port pairs with their best paths
   */
  getActiveSupplyRoutes(): Array<{
    supplier: NetworkNode;
    port: NetworkNode;
    path: string[];
    cost: number;
    days: number;
    isBlocked: boolean;
  }> {
    const suppliers = this.getNodesByType("supplier");
    const ports = this.getNodesByType("entry_port");
    const routes: ReturnType<typeof this.getActiveSupplyRoutes> = [];

    for (const supplier of suppliers) {
      for (const port of ports) {
        // Check if path exists without blocked constraints first
        const rawPath = this.dijkstra(supplier.id, port.id);
        const isBlocked =
          rawPath === null ||
          rawPath.path.some((n) => this.blockedNodes.has(n));

        const bestPath = rawPath;
        routes.push({
          supplier,
          port,
          path: bestPath?.path ?? [],
          cost: bestPath?.totalCost ?? 0,
          days: bestPath?.totalDays ?? 0,
          isBlocked,
        });
      }
    }

    return routes;
  }
}

// ── Singleton factory ─────────────────────────────────────────

let _instance: DigitalTwin | null = null;

export function getDigitalTwin(): DigitalTwin {
  if (!_instance) {
    _instance = new DigitalTwin();
  }
  return _instance;
}

export function resetDigitalTwin(): void {
  _instance = null;
}

// ============================================================
// KAVACH — Macro-Economic Shock Impact Calculator
//
// Formulas:
//   Supply Deficit % = (BaselineSupply - ActiveSupply) / BaselineSupply
//   Domestic Fuel Price Spike % = Supply Deficit % × 1.45
//   Refinery Run Rate Hit % = Supply Deficit % × 0.85
//   Daily GDP Impact (USD) = Supply Deficit (Barrels) × $42 friction
// ============================================================

import {
  INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD,
  FUEL_PRICE_SPIKE_MULTIPLIER,
  REFINERY_RUNRATE_MULTIPLIER,
  GDP_FRICTION_USD_PER_BARREL,
  SIM_DAYS,
} from "@/lib/config";

// ── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface MacroImpactResult {
  scenarioId: string;
  supplyDeficitBPD: number;
  supplyDeficitPct: number;         // fraction (0–1)

  // Price impacts
  fuelPriceSpikePercentage: number; // % spike in domestic fuel price
  crudePriceBreakevenUSD: number;   // breakeven Brent equiv. under rerouted cost

  // Refinery impacts
  refineryRunRateDropPct: number;   // % drop in throughput
  estimatedRefineryLossBPD: number; // BPD of capacity lost

  // GDP impacts
  dailyGDPLossUSD: number;
  fifteenDayGDPLossUSD: number;     // 15-day cumulative
  annualizedGDPLossUSD: number;     // extrapolated to 1 year

  // Trade balance impact
  additionalImportCostPerDay: number;  // USD from rerouting surcharge
  additionalTransitDays: number;

  // Human-readable labels
  fuelPriceSpikeLabel: string;
  gdpLossLabel: string;
  refineryHitLabel: string;
  supplyDeficitLabel: string;

  // Alert tier
  macroAlertLevel: "LOW" | "MODERATE" | "SEVERE" | "CATASTROPHIC";
  
  // Time-series shock curve (15 days)
  dailyImpactSeries: DailyMacroPoint[];
}

export interface DailyMacroPoint {
  day: number;
  date: string;
  gdpLossUSD: number;
  fuelPriceSpikeAdditionalPct: number;
  refineryRunRatePct: number; // operational %, not drop
  cumulativeGDPLossUSD: number;
}

// ── Macro Impact Calculator ──────────────────────────────────

export class MacroImpactCalculator {

  /**
   * Compute all macro-economic shock metrics given supply deficit
   *
   * @param supplyDeficitPct - fraction of daily demand unmet (0–1)
   * @param avgRerouteCostIncreasePerBBL - additional USD/barrel from rerouting
   * @param additionalTransitDays - extra days from alternate routing
   * @param scenarioId - scenario identifier
   * @param startDate - simulation date
   * @param overrides - optional assumption overrides
   */
  compute(
    supplyDeficitPct: number,
    avgRerouteCostIncreasePerBBL: number,
    additionalTransitDays: number,
    scenarioId: string,
    startDate: Date = new Date(),
    overrides?: {
      gdpFrictionUsdPerBarrel?: number;
      fuelPriceSpikeMultiplier?: number;
      refineryRunrateMultiplier?: number;
    }
  ): MacroImpactResult {

    // Clamp deficit to valid range
    const deficit = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, supplyDeficitPct));

    // Resolve overrideable constants
    const gdpFriction = overrides?.gdpFrictionUsdPerBarrel ?? GDP_FRICTION_USD_PER_BARREL;
    const fuelMultiplier = overrides?.fuelPriceSpikeMultiplier ?? FUEL_PRICE_SPIKE_MULTIPLIER;
    const refineryMultiplier = overrides?.refineryRunrateMultiplier ?? REFINERY_RUNRATE_MULTIPLIER;

    // ── Core Metrics ────────────────────────────────────────

    const supplyDeficitBPD = Math.round(deficit * INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD);

    // Domestic Fuel Price Spike % = Deficit% × fuelMultiplier
    const fuelPriceSpikePercentage =
      Math.round(deficit * fuelMultiplier * 1000) / 10;

    // Refinery Run Rate Hit % = Deficit% × refineryMultiplier
    const refineryRunRateDropPct =
      Math.round(deficit * refineryMultiplier * 1000) / 10;

    const estimatedRefineryLossBPD = Math.round(
      deficit * refineryMultiplier * 1_500_000 // total refinery capacity ~1.5M BPD
    );

    // Daily GDP Impact = Deficit BPD × gdpFriction
    const dailyGDPLossUSD = supplyDeficitBPD * gdpFriction;

    // Crude breakeven adjusted for rerouting cost
    const baseBrentEquiv = 80; // baseline Brent price USD/BBL
    const crudePriceBreakevenUSD =
      baseBrentEquiv + avgRerouteCostIncreasePerBBL;

    // Additional import cost per day from rerouting
    const reroutedImportBPD = INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD * 0.88 * (1 - deficit);
    const additionalImportCostPerDay = Math.round(
      reroutedImportBPD * avgRerouteCostIncreasePerBBL
    );

    // ── Time-Series (15 days) ────────────────────────────────
    // Shock intensifies in first 5 days (ramp-up), then plateaus

    const dailyImpactSeries: DailyMacroPoint[] = [];
    let cumulativeGDP = 0;

    for (let day = 0; day <= SIM_DAYS; day++) {
      const rampFactor = Math.min(1, day / 5); // ramp from 0→1 over 5 days
      const dayDeficit = deficit * rampFactor;

      const gdpLoss =
        Math.round(dayDeficit * INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD) *
        gdpFriction;

      cumulativeGDP += gdpLoss;

      const date = new Date(startDate);
      date.setDate(date.getDate() + day);

      dailyImpactSeries.push({
        day,
        date: date.toISOString().split("T")[0],
        gdpLossUSD: gdpLoss,
        fuelPriceSpikeAdditionalPct:
          Math.round(dayDeficit * fuelMultiplier * 1000) / 10,
        refineryRunRatePct: Math.round((1 - dayDeficit * refineryMultiplier) * 100),
        cumulativeGDPLossUSD: cumulativeGDP,
      });
    }

    // ── Cumulative / Annualized ──────────────────────────────

    const fifteenDayGDPLossUSD = dailyGDPLossUSD * SIM_DAYS;
    const annualizedGDPLossUSD = dailyGDPLossUSD * 365;

    // ── Alert Level ──────────────────────────────────────────
    let macroAlertLevel: MacroImpactResult["macroAlertLevel"] = "LOW";
    if (deficit >= 0.5) macroAlertLevel = "CATASTROPHIC";
    else if (deficit >= 0.3) macroAlertLevel = "SEVERE";
    else if (deficit >= 0.15) macroAlertLevel = "MODERATE";

    // ── Labels ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    const fuelPriceSpikeLabel = `+${fuelPriceSpikePercentage.toFixed(1)}%`;
    const gdpLossLabel = this._formatUSD(dailyGDPLossUSD);
    const refineryHitLabel = `-${refineryRunRateDropPct.toFixed(1)}%`;
    const supplyDeficitLabel = `${(deficit * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;

    return {
      scenarioId,
      supplyDeficitBPD,
      supplyDeficitPct: deficit,
      fuelPriceSpikePercentage,
      crudePriceBreakevenUSD,
      refineryRunRateDropPct,
      estimatedRefineryLossBPD,
      dailyGDPLossUSD,
      fifteenDayGDPLossUSD,
      annualizedGDPLossUSD,
      additionalImportCostPerDay,
      additionalTransitDays,
      fuelPriceSpikeLabel,
      gdpLossLabel,
      refineryHitLabel,
      supplyDeficitLabel,
      macroAlertLevel,
      dailyImpactSeries,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Format USD values as readable strings (M/B suffix)
   */
  private _formatUSD(value: number): string {
    if (value >= 1_000_000_000) {
      return `$${(value / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(2)}B`;
    } else if (value >= 1_000_000) {
      return `$${(value / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
    } else if (value >= 1_000) {
      return `$${(value / 1_000).toFixed(0)}K`;
    }
    return `$${value.toFixed(0)}`;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// KAVACH — Supply Route Optimizer (Rerouter)
// Uses Dijkstra with crude grade penalties, capacity checks,
// and distance-weighted cost to find optimal alternate routes
// when chokepoints are blocked.
// ============================================================

import {
  DigitalTwin,
  NetworkNode,
  NetworkEdge,
  CrudeType,
} from "@/lib/engine/digitalTwin";
import {
  GRADE_MISMATCH_SURCHARGE_PER_BARREL,
  GRADE_MISMATCH_DELAY_DAYS,
  INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD,
  IMPORT_DEPENDENCY_PCT,
} from "@/lib/config";

// ── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RouteOption {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  supplier: NetworkNode;
  port: NetworkNode;
  path: string[];
  pathLabels: string[];
  totalCostPerBarrel: number;
  totalTransitDays: number;
  capacityBPD: number;
  crudeType: CrudeType;
  gradeMismatch: boolean;
  gradeSurchargePBL: number;
  gradeDelayDays: number;
  isPrimary: boolean;
  isBlocked: boolean;
  status: "OPERATIONAL" | "REROUTED" | "BLOCKED";
}

export interface RerouteResult {
  scenario: string;
  blockedNodes: string[];
  blockedBPD: number;        // supply cut off by blockage
  activeBPD: number;         // supply flowing through rerouted paths
  unservedBPD: number;       // demand still unmet
  supplyDeficitPct: number;  // fraction of total demand unmet
  routes: RouteOption[];
  reroutedRoutes: RouteOption[];
  blockedRoutes: RouteOption[];
  avgRerouteCostIncrease: number; // USD/barrel delta vs baseline
  avgRerouteDelayDays: number;    // additional transit days
}

// ── Rerouter Class ───────────────────────────────────────────

export class Rerouter {
  private twin: DigitalTwin;

  constructor(twin: DigitalTwin) {
    this.twin = twin;
  }

  /**
   * Resolve the bottleneck capacity along a path (minimum edge capacity)
   */
  private pathCapacity(path: string[]): number {
    let minCap = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < path.length - 1; i++) {
      const fromId = path[i];
      const toId = path[i + 1];
      const graph = this.twin.getGraph();

      graph.forEachEdge(fromId, toId, (_key, attrs) => {
        const edge = attrs as NetworkEdge;
        minCap = Math.min(minCap, edge.capacity_bpd);
      });
    }
    return minCap === Infinity ? 0 : minCap;
  }

  /**
   * Determine crude type flowing along a path (based on supplier)
   */
  private pathCrudeType(supplier: NetworkNode): CrudeType {
    return supplier.crude_type ?? "Mixed";
  }

  /**
   * Compute grade mismatch penalty for a refinery
   */
  private computeGradePenalty(
    supplierCrude: CrudeType,
    refineryConfigure: CrudeType
  ): { mismatch: boolean; surcharge: number; delayDays: number } {
    // Mismatch occurs when refinery expects Sour but gets Sweet, or vice versa
    if (refineryConfigure === "Mixed" || supplierCrude === "Mixed") {
      return { mismatch: false, surcharge: 0, delayDays: 0 };
    }
    if (supplierCrude !== refineryConfigure) {
      return {
        mismatch: true,
        surcharge: GRADE_MISMATCH_SURCHARGE_PER_BARREL,
        delayDays: GRADE_MISMATCH_DELAY_DAYS,
      };
    }
    return { mismatch: false, surcharge: 0, delayDays: 0 };
  }

  /**
   * Find all available routes from a supplier to a port, considering blockages.
   * Returns primary and alternate paths with full cost breakdown.
   */
  private findRouteOptions(
    supplier: NetworkNode,
    port: NetworkNode
  ): RouteOption[] {
    const options: RouteOption[] = [];

    // Try Dijkstra path (with blocked nodes excluded)
    const result = this.twin.dijkstra(supplier.id, port.id);

    if (result && result.path.length > 1) {
      const crude = this.pathCrudeType(supplier);
      const capacity = this.pathCapacity(result.path);

      // Check if any node in the path is a blocked chokepoint
      const blocked = result.path.some((n) => this.twin.isBlocked(n));

      // Get path labels
      const pathLabels = result.path.map(
        (id) => this.twin.getNode(id)?.label ?? id
      );

      // Check if this uses primary edges
      const isPrimary = result.path.includes("strait_of_hormuz");

      // Find connecting refinery to compute grade mismatch
      // (the port feeds a specific refinery, we approximate via port->refinery link)
      const refinery = this._getLinkedRefinery(port.id);
      const configuredCrude: CrudeType =
        (refinery?.configured_crude as CrudeType) ?? "Mixed";

      const { mismatch, surcharge, delayDays } = this.computeGradePenalty(
        crude,
        configuredCrude
      );

      const totalCost = result.totalCost + surcharge;

      options.push({
        id: `${supplier.id}_${port.id}`,
        label: `${supplier.label} → ${port.label}`,
        supplier,
        port,
        path: result.path,
        pathLabels,
        totalCostPerBarrel: totalCost,
        totalTransitDays: result.totalDays + delayDays,
        capacityBPD: capacity,
        crudeType: crude,
        gradeMismatch: mismatch,
        gradeSurchargePBL: surcharge,
        gradeDelayDays: delayDays,
        isPrimary,
        isBlocked: blocked,
        status: blocked ? "BLOCKED" : isPrimary ? "OPERATIONAL" : "REROUTED",
      });
    } else {
      // No path found (completely blocked)
      options.push({
        id: `${supplier.id}_${port.id}`,
        label: `${supplier.label} → ${port.label}`,
        supplier,
        port,
        path: [],
        pathLabels: [],
        totalCostPerBarrel: 0,
        totalTransitDays: 0,
        capacityBPD: 0,
        crudeType: this.pathCrudeType(supplier),
        gradeMismatch: false,
        gradeSurchargePBL: 0,
        gradeDelayDays: 0,
        isPrimary: false,
        isBlocked: true,
        status: "BLOCKED",
      });
    }

    return options;
  }

  /**
   * Look up the primary refinery linked to a port
   */
  private _getLinkedRefinery(portId: string): NetworkNode | null {
    const graph = this.twin.getGraph();
    let refinery: NetworkNode | null = null;

    if (!graph.hasNode(portId)) return null;

    graph.forEachOutEdge(portId, (_key, _attrs, _source, target) => {
      const node = this.twin.getNode(target);
      if (node?.type === "refinery") refinery = node;
    });

    return refinery;
  }

  /**
   * Full scenario rerouting computation.
   * Blocks nodes, recomputes all routes, measures supply shortfall.
   *
   * Formula: Path Cost = Σ(Base Edge Cost) + Distance Penalty + Grade Mismatch Cost
   */
  computeRerouting(
    scenarioId: string,
    blockedNodeIds: string[]
  ): RerouteResult {
    // Apply blockages
    this.twin.blockNodes(blockedNodeIds);

    const suppliers = this.twin.getNodesByType("supplier");
    const ports = this.twin.getNodesByType("entry_port");

    // Compute baseline (no blockage) routes first
    this.twin.clearBlocks();
    const baselineRoutes: RouteOption[] = [];
    for (const supplier of suppliers) {
      for (const port of ports) {
        const opts = this.findRouteOptions(supplier, port);
        baselineRoutes.push(...opts);
      }
    }
    const baselineAvgCost =
      baselineRoutes.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.totalCostPerBarrel, 0) /
      baselineRoutes.length;
    const baselineAvgDays =
      baselineRoutes.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.totalTransitDays, 0) /
      baselineRoutes.length;

    // Re-apply blockages and compute rerouted routes
    this.twin.blockNodes(blockedNodeIds);
    const allRoutes: RouteOption[] = [];
    for (const supplier of suppliers) {
      for (const port of ports) {
        const opts = this.findRouteOptions(supplier, port);
        allRoutes.push(...opts);
      }
    }

    const operationalRoutes = allRoutes.filter((r) => !r.isBlocked);
    const blockedRoutes = allRoutes.filter((r) => r.isBlocked);
    const reroutedRoutes = allRoutes.filter(
      (r) => !r.isBlocked && !r.isPrimary
    );

    // Calculate active supply volume
    const activeBPD = operationalRoutes.reduce(
      (sum, r) => sum + Math.min(r.capacityBPD, INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD / 3),
      0
    );

    // Total demand for import
    const totalImportDemand = INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD * IMPORT_DEPENDENCY_PCT;

    // Blocked supply (capacity through blocked paths)
    const blockedBPD = blockedRoutes.reduce(
      (sum, r) =>
        sum +
        (baselineRoutes.find(
          (b) => b.supplier.id === r.supplier.id && b.port.id === r.port.id
        )?.capacityBPD ?? 0),
      0
    );

    const unservedBPD = Math.max(0, totalImportDemand - activeBPD);
    const supplyDeficitPct = unservedBPD / INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD;

    // Cost delta
    const reroutedAvgCost =
      reroutedRoutes.length > 0
        ? reroutedRoutes.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.totalCostPerBarrel, 0) /
          reroutedRoutes.length
        : baselineAvgCost;

    const avgRerouteCostIncrease = reroutedAvgCost - baselineAvgCost;

    const reroutedAvgDays =
      reroutedRoutes.length > 0
        ? reroutedRoutes.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.totalTransitDays, 0) /
          reroutedRoutes.length
        : baselineAvgDays;

    const avgRerouteDelayDays = reroutedAvgDays - baselineAvgDays;

    // Clear for next computation
    this.twin.clearBlocks();

    return {
      scenario: scenarioId,
      blockedNodes: blockedNodeIds,
      blockedBPD: Math.round(blockedBPD),
      activeBPD: Math.round(activeBPD),
      unservedBPD: Math.round(unservedBPD),
      supplyDeficitPct: Math.min(1, supplyDeficitPct),
      routes: allRoutes,
      reroutedRoutes,
      blockedRoutes,
      avgRerouteCostIncrease: Math.round(avgRerouteCostIncrease * 100) / 100,
      avgRerouteDelayDays: Math.round(avgRerouteDelayDays * 10) / 10,
    };
  }
}

// ============================================================
// KAVACH — Signal Mapper
// Translates a RiskAssessment.impacted_chokepoint value into
// the actual blocked_nodes[] IDs used by network.json /
// the Digital Twin, so a live news signal can feed directly
// into the rerouter without human intervention.
// ============================================================

import type { RiskAssessment } from "@/lib/agents/riskParser";

// ── Chokepoint → Node ID map ─────────────────────────────────

const CHOKEPOINT_NODE_MAP: Record<string, string[]> = {
  Strait_of_Hormuz: ["strait_of_hormuz"],
  Bab_el_Mandeb: ["bab_el_mandeb"],
  Suez_Canal: ["suez_canal"],
  // Cape of Good Hope is the fallback route — blockage is not modeled
  Cape_of_Good_Hope: [],
  // Multiple: block both primary chokepoints
  Multiple: ["strait_of_hormuz", "bab_el_mandeb"],
  None: [],
};

// ── Keyword hints for "Multiple" disambiguation ──────────────
// If the event_summary mentions only one specific chokepoint,
// we can narrow "Multiple" to just that one set.

const SUMMARY_HINTS: Array<{ keywords: string[]; nodes: string[] }> = [
  {
    keywords: ["hormuz", "persian gulf", "ras tanura", "das island"],
    nodes: ["strait_of_hormuz"],
  },
  {
    keywords: ["bab", "mandeb", "red sea", "houthi", "aden", "hodeidah"],
    nodes: ["bab_el_mandeb"],
  },
  {
    keywords: ["suez", "egypt", "mediterranean"],
    nodes: ["suez_canal"],
  },
];

// ── Main mapping function ─────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Derive the list of blocked node IDs from a structured RiskAssessment.
 *
 * Rules:
 *  1. Use CHOKEPOINT_NODE_MAP as the primary lookup.
 *  2. For "Multiple", scan event_summary + affected_suppliers for
 *     keyword hints to see if we can be more precise; fall back to
 *     ["strait_of_hormuz", "bab_el_mandeb"] if ambiguous.
 *  3. "None" / "Cape_of_Good_Hope" → [] (baseline, no blockage).
 *
 * @param assessment  Structured risk output from parseRiskFromNews
 * @returns           Array of node IDs to pass to rerouter.computeRerouting()
 */
export function chokepointToNodeIds(assessment: RiskAssessment): string[] {
  const cp = assessment.impacted_chokepoint;

  // Fast-path: known static mapping
  if (cp !== "Multiple") {
    return CHOKEPOINT_NODE_MAP[cp] ?? [];
  }

  // "Multiple" — try to narrow down via event text
  const textToScan = [
    assessment.event_summary ?? "",
    assessment.recommended_action ?? "",
    ...(assessment.affected_suppliers ?? []),
  ]
    .join(" ")
    .toLowerCase();

  const matchedNodes = new Set<string>();

  for (const hint of SUMMARY_HINTS) {
    if (hint.keywords.some((kw) => textToScan.includes(kw))) {
      hint.nodes.forEach((n) => matchedNodes.add(n));
    }
  }

  // If we found specific nodes via hints, use those; otherwise fall back
  return matchedNodes.size > 0
    ? Array.from(matchedNodes)
    : (CHOKEPOINT_NODE_MAP["Multiple"] as string[]);
}

/**
 * Returns a human-readable label for a dynamic scenario derived from a
 * RiskAssessment, suitable for display in the UI.
 */
export function buildDynamicScenarioLabel(assessment: RiskAssessment): string {
  const cp = assessment.impacted_chokepoint.replace(/_/g, " ");
  return `Live Signal: ${cp} — ${assessment.threat_level}`;
}

// ============================================================
// KAVACH — SPR Drawdown Simulator
// Computes 15-day Strategic Petroleum Reserve depletion curves
// under unmitigated vs. rerouted supply scenarios.
//
// Formula:
//   Reserve(t) = InitialSPR - ∫₀ᵗ (DailyDemand - ActiveImportSupply) dt
//
// Baseline SPR = 9.5 days × 5,000,000 BPD = 47,500,000 barrels
// ============================================================

import {
  INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD,
  SPR_BASELINE_BARRELS,
  SPR_BASELINE_DAYS,
  SIM_DAYS,
} from "@/lib/config";

// ── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface SPRDayPoint {
  day: number;
  date: string;
  reserveBarrels: number;       // total barrels remaining
  reserveDays: number;          // days of cover left at current demand
  drawdownBarrels: number;      // barrels drawn this day
  activeSupplyBPD: number;      // import supply flowing in
  netDeficitBPD: number;        // demand - active supply (positive = drawdown)
  cumulativeDrawdown: number;   // total drawn since day 0
  pctRemaining: number;         // % of initial SPR left
  alertStatus: "NORMAL" | "WARNING" | "CRITICAL" | "DEPLETED";
}

export interface SPRSimResult {
  scenarioId: string;
  initialSPRBarrels: number;
  initialSPRDays: number;
  dailyDemandBPD: number;
  trajectoryUnmitigated: SPRDayPoint[];  // no rerouting
  trajectoryRerouted: SPRDayPoint[];     // with active rerouting
  exhaustionDayUnmitigated: number | null;
  exhaustionDayRerouted: number | null;
  daysSaved: number;  // rerouting buys this many extra days
  peakDrawdownRateUnmitigated: number;  // BPD
  peakDrawdownRateRerouted: number;     // BPD
}

// ── SPR Simulator ────────────────────────────────────────────

export class SPRSimulator {

  /**
   * Simulate the SPR drawdown curve over SIM_DAYS.
   *
   * @param activeBPD_unmitigated - supply BPD if no rerouting happens
   * @param activeBPD_rerouted - supply BPD after rerouting is active
   * @param scenarioId - scenario identifier
   * @param startDate - simulation start date (defaults to today)
   * @param overrides - optional assumption overrides
   */
  simulate(
    activeBPD_unmitigated: number,
    activeBPD_rerouted: number,
    scenarioId: string,
    startDate: Date = new Date(),
    overrides?: { domesticProductionPct?: number }
  ): SPRSimResult {

    const trajectoryUnmitigated = this._computeTrajectory(
      activeBPD_unmitigated,
      startDate,
      overrides?.domesticProductionPct
    );

    const trajectoryRerouted = this._computeTrajectory(
      activeBPD_rerouted,
      startDate,
      overrides?.domesticProductionPct
    );

    const exhaustionDayUnmitigated = this._findExhaustionDay(trajectoryUnmitigated);
    const exhaustionDayRerouted = this._findExhaustionDay(trajectoryRerouted);

    const daysSaved =
      exhaustionDayUnmitigated !== null && exhaustionDayRerouted !== null
        ? exhaustionDayRerouted - exhaustionDayUnmitigated
        : exhaustionDayRerouted !== null
          ? 0
          : exhaustionDayUnmitigated !== null
            ? SIM_DAYS - exhaustionDayUnmitigated
            : 0;

    const peakDrawdownUnmitigated = Math.max(
      ...trajectoryUnmitigated.map((d) => d.drawdownBarrels)
    );
    const peakDrawdownRerouted = Math.max(
      ...trajectoryRerouted.map((d) => d.drawdownBarrels)
    );

    return {
      scenarioId,
      initialSPRBarrels: SPR_BASELINE_BARRELS,
      initialSPRDays: SPR_BASELINE_DAYS,
      dailyDemandBPD: INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD,
      trajectoryUnmitigated,
      trajectoryRerouted,
      exhaustionDayUnmitigated,
      exhaustionDayRerouted,
      daysSaved: Math.max(0, daysSaved),
      peakDrawdownRateUnmitigated: peakDrawdownUnmitigated,
      peakDrawdownRateRerouted: peakDrawdownRerouted,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Compute day-by-day SPR trajectory using discrete integration.
   * Reserve(t) = Reserve(t-1) - max(0, DailyDemand - ActiveSupply)
   *
   * When reserve hits 0, we report DEPLETED status.
   * We also model a 20% domestic production offset to active supply.
   */
  private _computeTrajectory(
    activeImportBPD: number,
    startDate: Date,
    domesticProductionPct: number = 0.12
  ): SPRDayPoint[] {
    const domesticProduction = INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD * domesticProductionPct; // ~12% domestic by default
    const totalActiveSupply = activeImportBPD + domesticProduction;

    let currentReserve = SPR_BASELINE_BARRELS;
    let cumulativeDrawdown = 0;
    const trajectory: SPRDayPoint[] = [];

    for (let day = 0; day <= SIM_DAYS; day++) {
      const netDeficitBPD = Math.max(
        0,
        INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD - totalActiveSupply
      );

      // Draw from SPR to cover deficit (can't draw more than what's left)
      const drawdownToday = Math.min(netDeficitBPD, currentReserve);
      cumulativeDrawdown += drawdownToday;
      currentReserve = Math.max(0, currentReserve - drawdownToday);

      const reserveDays =
        netDeficitBPD > 0
          ? currentReserve / netDeficitBPD
          : currentReserve / INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD;

      const pctRemaining = currentReserve / SPR_BASELINE_BARRELS;

      let alertStatus: SPRDayPoint["alertStatus"] = "NORMAL";
      if (currentReserve === 0) alertStatus = "DEPLETED";
      else if (pctRemaining < 0.15) alertStatus = "CRITICAL";
      else if (pctRemaining < 0.4) alertStatus = "WARNING";

      const date = new Date(startDate);
      date.setDate(date.getDate() + day);

      trajectory.push({
        day,
        date: date.toISOString().split("T")[0],
        reserveBarrels: Math.round(currentReserve),
        reserveDays: Math.round(reserveDays * 10) / 10,
        drawdownBarrels: Math.round(drawdownToday),
        activeSupplyBPD: Math.round(totalActiveSupply),
        netDeficitBPD: Math.round(netDeficitBPD),
        cumulativeDrawdown: Math.round(cumulativeDrawdown),
        pctRemaining: Math.round(pctRemaining * 1000) / 10, // to 1 decimal %
        alertStatus,
      });
    }

    return trajectory;
  }

  /**
   * Find the first day the SPR hits 0 (exhaustion day)
   */
  private _findExhaustionDay(trajectory: SPRDayPoint[]): number | null {
    const depleted = trajectory.find((d) => d.alertStatus === "DEPLETED");
    return depleted ? depleted.day : null;
  }

  /**
   * Compute unmitigated supply (zero active imports — worst case)
   * @param domesticProductionPct - fraction of demand met by domestic production (default 0.12)
   */
  static worstCaseSupplyBPD(domesticProductionPct: number = 0.12): number {
    // Only domestic production remains
    return INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD * domesticProductionPct;
  }

  /**
   * Compute rerouted supply estimate given a supply deficit fraction.
   * @param deficitPct - fraction of demand unmet
   * @param rerouteRecoveryPct - fraction of disrupted supply recovered via rerouting (default 0.60)
   * @param domesticProductionPct - fraction met domestically (default 0.12)
   */
  static reroutedSupplyBPD(
    deficitPct: number,
    rerouteRecoveryPct: number = 0.6,
    domesticProductionPct: number = 0.12
  ): number {
    const baseImportBPD = INDIA_DAILY_DEMAND_BPD * (1 - domesticProductionPct);
    const disruptedBPD = baseImportBPD * deficitPct;
    const recoveredBPD = disruptedBPD * rerouteRecoveryPct;
    return baseImportBPD - disruptedBPD + recoveredBPD;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// KAVACH — Live News Feed Module
// Fetches real-world maritime/energy articles from:
//   Primary:   GDELT DOC 2.0 API (no auth required)
//   Secondary: NewsAPI.org (optional NEWSAPI_KEY env var)
// Deduplicates, pre-filters, and caches results to avoid
// hammering external APIs on every render.
// ============================================================

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

// ── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RawArticle {
  title: string;
  url: string;
  source: string;
  publishedAt: string; // ISO string
  description?: string;
  provider: "gdelt" | "newsapi";
}

// ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

const CACHE_FILE = path.join(process.cwd(), "src/data/news_cache.json");
const CACHE_DURATION_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000; // 30 minutes

// Chokepoint / tanker attack keywords — queries both sources
const QUERY_KEYWORDS = [
  "Strait of Hormuz",
  "Bab-el-Mandeb",
  "Houthi",
  "Suez Canal",
  "tanker attack",
  "Red Sea shipping",
  "Ras Tanura",
  "Novorossiysk export",
  "crude oil disruption",
];

// Pre-filter relevance keywords (cheap check before Gemini call)
const RELEVANCE_KEYWORDS = [
  "hormuz", "bab", "mandeb", "houthi", "suez", "tanker",
  "crude", "oil", "ras tanura", "novorossiysk", "red sea",
  "shipping", "disruption", "attack", "blockade", "chokepoint",
  "persian gulf", "arabian sea", "india", "refinery",
];

// ── Cache helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────

interface NewsCache {
  cachedAt: number;
  articles: RawArticle[];
}

function readCache(): NewsCache | null {
  try {
    if (!fs.existsSync(CACHE_FILE)) return null;
    const stats = fs.statSync(CACHE_FILE);
    if (Date.now() - stats.mtimeMs > CACHE_DURATION_MS) return null;
    const content = fs.readFileSync(CACHE_FILE, "utf-8");
    return JSON.parse(content) as NewsCache;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function writeCache(articles: RawArticle[]): void {
  try {
    const cache: NewsCache = { cachedAt: Date.now(), articles };
    fs.writeFileSync(CACHE_FILE, JSON.stringify(cache, null, 2), "utf-8");
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[KAVACH] Failed to write news cache:", err);
  }
}

// ── GDELT DOC 2.0 Fetcher (no auth required) ─────────────────

export async function fetchGdeltArticles(hoursBack: number = 6): Promise<RawArticle[]> {
  try {
    const query = encodeURIComponent(
      QUERY_KEYWORDS.slice(0, 5).join(" OR ")
    );
    const url =
      `https://api.gdeltproject.org/api/v2/doc/doc?query=${query}` +
      `&mode=artlist&maxrecords=25&format=json&timespan=${hoursBack}h` +
      `&sort=datedesc&sourcelang=english`;

    const res = await fetch(url, {
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
      headers: { "User-Agent": "KAVACH-EnergySecurityPlatform/1.0" },
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      console.error(`[KAVACH] GDELT returned ${res.status}`);
      return [];
    }

    const json = await res.json();
    const articles: GdeltArticle[] = json.articles ?? [];

    return articles.map((a) => ({
      title: a.title ?? "",
      url: a.url ?? "",
      source: a.domain ?? "GDELT",
      publishedAt: a.seendate
        ? parseGdeltDate(a.seendate)
        : new Date().toISOString(),
      description: a.title ?? "",
      provider: "gdelt" as const,
    }));
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[KAVACH] GDELT fetch error:", err);
    return [];
  }
}

interface GdeltArticle {
  url?: string;
  title?: string;
  domain?: string;
  seendate?: string; // YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ
}

function parseGdeltDate(gdeltDate: string): string {
  // Format: "20240715T143000Z" → ISO
  try {
    const y = gdeltDate.slice(0, 4);
    const mo = gdeltDate.slice(4, 6);
    const d = gdeltDate.slice(6, 8);
    const h = gdeltDate.slice(9, 11);
    const mi = gdeltDate.slice(11, 13);
    const s = gdeltDate.slice(13, 15);
    return new Date(`${y}-${mo}-${d}T${h}:${mi}:${s}Z`).toISOString();
  } catch {
    return new Date().toISOString();
  }
}

// ── NewsAPI.org Fetcher (optional NEWSAPI_KEY) ────────────────

export async function fetchNewsApiArticles(hoursBack: number = 6): Promise<RawArticle[]> {
  const apiKey = process.env.NEWSAPI_KEY;
  if (!apiKey || apiKey === "your_newsapi_key_here") {
    // Graceful skip — not a hard failure
    return [];
  }

  try {
    const from = new Date(Date.now() - hoursBack * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
    const q = encodeURIComponent(
      "Hormuz OR Bab-el-Mandeb OR Houthi OR Suez OR tanker OR \"crude oil\""
    );
    const url =
      `https://newsapi.org/v2/everything?q=${q}&from=${from}` +
      `&language=en&sortBy=publishedAt&pageSize=20&apiKey=${apiKey}`;

    const res = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000) });

    if (!res.ok) {
      console.error(`[KAVACH] NewsAPI returned ${res.status}`);
      return [];
    }

    const json = await res.json();
    const articles: NewsApiArticle[] = json.articles ?? [];

    return articles.map((a) => ({
      title: a.title ?? "",
      url: a.url ?? "",
      source: a.source?.name ?? "NewsAPI",
      publishedAt: a.publishedAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
      description: a.description ?? a.title ?? "",
      provider: "newsapi" as const,
    }));
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[KAVACH] NewsAPI fetch error:", err);
    return [];
  }
}

interface NewsApiArticle {
  title?: string;
  url?: string;
  source?: { name?: string };
  publishedAt?: string;
  description?: string;
}

// ── Deduplication ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export function deduplicateArticles(articles: RawArticle[]): RawArticle[] {
  const seenUrls = new Set<string>();
  const seenTitles = new Set<string>();
  const result: RawArticle[] = [];

  for (const article of articles) {
    const normUrl = article.url.toLowerCase().split("?")[0];
    const normTitle = article.title.toLowerCase().slice(0, 60);

    if (seenUrls.has(normUrl) || seenTitles.has(normTitle)) continue;
    if (!article.url || !article.title || article.title === "[Removed]") continue;

    seenUrls.add(normUrl);
    seenTitles.add(normTitle);
    result.push(article);
  }

  return result;
}

// ── Pre-filter (cheap relevance check before Gemini) ─────────

/**
 * Returns a relevance score 0.0–1.0 based on keyword matches in
 * title + description. Articles below 0.2 are skipped to avoid
 * burning Gemini quota on low-signal content.
 */
export function relevanceScore(article: RawArticle): number {
  const text = `${article.title} ${article.description ?? ""}`.toLowerCase();
  const hits = RELEVANCE_KEYWORDS.filter((kw) => text.includes(kw)).length;
  return Math.min(1, hits / 4); // 4 hits = score 1.0
}

export const RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD = 0.2;

// ── Main orchestrator ─────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Fetch, merge, dedup, and return all candidate articles.
 * Uses file cache with 30-minute TTL to avoid hammering external APIs.
 *
 * @param hoursBack  How far back to look for articles (default 6h)
 * @param forceRefresh  Bypass cache and fetch fresh
 */
export async function getLatestArticles(
  hoursBack: number = 6,
  forceRefresh = false
): Promise<RawArticle[]> {
  if (!forceRefresh) {
    const cached = readCache();
    if (cached) {
      console.log("[KAVACH] Serving news from cache");
      return cached.articles;
    }
  }

  console.log("[KAVACH] Fetching fresh news articles…");

  const [gdelt, newsapi] = await Promise.all([
    fetchGdeltArticles(hoursBack),
    fetchNewsApiArticles(hoursBack),
  ]);

  const merged = deduplicateArticles([...gdelt, ...newsapi]);

  // Sort by publishedAt descending
  merged.sort(
    (a, b) =>
      new Date(b.publishedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.publishedAt).getTime()
  );

  writeCache(merged);
  return merged;
}
